items.title: 凱基證完成193億元聯合授信案 7家金融機構參與
items.title_en: KGI Securities Completes NT$19.3 Billion Syndicated Loan with 7 Financial Institutions
paras: 凱基證券與第一商業銀行和銀行團於今(7)日完成3年期新台幣193億元聯合授信案簽約，凱基證說明，此主要支應中期營運週轉金需求，獲得銀行團支持，不僅為未來營運發展提供充足資金，更展現金融同業對凱基證長期發展策略與經營成果的高度認同。
本案由第一商業銀行、臺灣銀行、兆豐國際商業銀行和華南商業銀行統籌主辦，彰化商業銀行擔任共同主辦銀行，並邀集台灣中小企業銀行和樂天國際商業銀行參貸，共計7家金融機構參與。
凱基證說明，聯貸資金到位後，將有助強化資金調度彈性及優化資金籌措結構，支應各項業務發展、海內外市場布局需求，進一步提升整體經營韌性與競爭力。
面對全球金融市場快速變化與投資需求持續升級，凱基證強調，將持續深化核心業務競爭優勢，推動數位金融創新服務，並積極推動永續金融與區域市場布局。
paras_en: KGI Securities and First Commercial Bank, together with a banking consortium, signed a three‑year NT$19.3 billion syndicated loan agreement today (the 7th). KGI explained that the facility mainly meets mid‑term operating working‑capital needs; backed by the consortium, it not only provides ample funding for future operational development but also reflects strong industry recognition of KGI’s long‑term strategy and performance.

The transaction is coordinated and led by First Commercial Bank, Bank of Taiwan, Mega International Commercial Bank and Hua Nan Commercial Bank, with Changhua Commercial Bank serving as co‑lead bank, and invites Taiwan SME Bank and Rakuten International Commercial Bank to participate, bringing the total to seven financial institutions.

KGI said that once the syndicated funds are in place, they will help strengthen cash‑flow flexibility and optimise the financing structure, support various business development and domestic and overseas market expansion needs, and further enhance overall operational resilience and competitiveness.

Facing rapid changes in global financial markets and continuously rising investment demand, KGI emphasized it will keep deepening its core business competitive advantages, promote digital financial‑innovation services, and actively advance sustainable finance and regional market expansion.

items.title: 穎崴擴產效益逐步顯 8月營收17億元飆新高
items.title_en: Winstar Expands Production Benefits Gradually, August Revenue Hits New High of 17.06 Billion TWD
paras: 測試介面大廠穎崴科技(6515-TW)今(7)日公告8月營收達17.06億元，月增6.58%，年增233.37%，累計今年前8月營收為98.1億元，較去年同期增加97.88%。受惠AI應用訂單持續帶動，穎崴8月營收創下單月歷史新高，不僅為連5月單月營收月增，更締造連3月單月營收創新高紀錄，累計前8月營收優於預期；面對全球AI客戶對高階測試迫切需求，穎崴迅速擴充產能，寫下連三個月業績創高佳績。
SEMICON TAIWAN 2026甫落幕，延續去年主軸，先進封裝今年持續領銜，產業地位從後段製程進階為系統整合，其中，在3DIC論壇公布3DIC先進封裝製造聯盟未來三年方向，並推動矽產業協同優化(STCO, Silicon-Technology Co-Optimization)，大會明確指引透過合作與聯盟，加速先進封裝生態系。
SEMICON TAIWAN此次也首度舉行「AI時代半導體測試與量測產業洞察暨倡議記者會」，共同探討AI晶片爆發下測試與量測產業面臨的關鍵轉折。先進封裝複雜度持續帶動測試設備及測試介面商機，穎崴「次世代先進測試介面平台」亦同步升級，尤其次世代超導測試座HyperSocket透過獨創導電膠架構，為先進封裝世代下大封裝、高電流、高針數等測試極限挑戰的最佳解決方案。

近期穎崴於《Advancedpackaging》期刊發表最新技術相關文章「OE的多樣性：CPO的量產關鍵瓶頸(Optical engine fragmentation: The critical bottleneck to CPO volume production)」，探討光學引擎規格的多樣性帶來CPO當前的百花齊放，同時指出未來隨著業界收斂光學引擎規格，才能實現具經濟效益且可量產的CPO生態系統。
近期AI科技大廠預估五大CSP業者2026年投入資料中心的支出將達8000億美元，並估2027年支出年增逾60%、達1.3兆美元；同時Hyperscaler AI基礎建設持續擴張，目前雲端業務在手訂單(Cloud industry backlog)已超過2兆美元。
AI熱潮使AI晶片需求持續增加，半導體測試供應鏈將在此趨勢下成長，穎崴長期耕耘半導體高階先進測試介面，在完整且深厚研發能量及全球技術支援布局下，從早期產品設計階段便與客戶共同開發，因此能兼顧效能與客戶需求，並滿足KGD (Known Good Die)的測試需求，提供客戶完整的一站式解決方案。
paras_en: Test‑interface giant Winstar Technology (6515‑TW) announced today (the 7th) that its August revenue reached NT$17.06 billion, up 6.58% month‑over‑month and 233.37% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months of this year was NT$98.1 billion, a 97.88% increase over the same period last year. Driven by continued AI‑application orders, August revenue set a single‑month historical high, marking the fifth consecutive month of month‑over‑month growth and the third straight month of record‑high single‑month revenue, with the first‑eight‑month total exceeding expectations. Facing strong global AI customer demand for high‑end testing, Winstar rapidly expanded capacity, achieving three consecutive months of record performance.

SEMICON TAIWAN 2026 has just concluded, continuing last year’s focus with advanced packaging leading the way this year. The industry’s position has moved from back‑end processing to system integration. At the 3DIC forum, the 3DIC Advanced Packaging Manufacturing Alliance unveiled its three‑year roadmap and promoted silicon‑industry co‑optimization (STCO). The conference clearly directed that cooperation and alliances should accelerate the advanced‑packaging ecosystem.

SEMICON TAIWAN also held, for the first time, an “AI‑Era Semiconductor Test and Measurement Industry Insight & Initiative Press Conference,” jointly discussing the critical turning points the test and measurement sector faces amid the AI‑chip boom. The growing complexity of advanced packaging continues to drive opportunities for test equipment and test‑interface providers. Winstar’s “next‑generation advanced test‑interface platform” is being upgraded in tandem, especially its next‑generation superconducting test socket, HyperSocket, which uses a proprietary conductive‑gel architecture to address the extreme testing challenges of large‑scale packages, high current and high pin‑count in the advanced‑packaging era.

Recently, Winstar published a technical article in the journal Advanced Packaging titled “Diversity of OEs: The Critical Bottleneck to CPO Volume Production (Optical Engine Fragmentation: The Critical Bottleneck to CPO Volume Production).” The paper examines how the variety of optical‑engine specifications has led to a proliferation of CPO designs today, and argues that industry convergence on optical‑engine specs will be necessary to achieve an economically viable, mass‑produced CPO ecosystem.

Recent estimates from major AI‑technology firms project that the five largest cloud‑service providers will spend US$800 billion on data‑center investments in 2026, with 2027 spending expected to grow over 60% year‑over‑year to US$1.3 trillion. Meanwhile, hyperscaler AI infrastructure continues to expand, and the cloud‑industry backlog now exceeds US$2 trillion.

The AI wave is driving sustained growth in AI‑chip demand, and the semiconductor test supply chain is set to expand with this trend. Winstar has long cultivated high‑end advanced test‑interface capabilities; with deep R&D resources and a global technical support network, it collaborates with customers from early product‑design stages, balancing performance with customer needs and meeting Known Good Die (KGD) testing requirements, thereby delivering a complete one‑stop solution.

items.title: 權值軍團發威！0053分割前夕飆漲近2% 0050逼近新高
items.title_en: Weight‑class Titans Surge! 0053 Jumps Nearly 2% Ahead of Split, 0050 Near New High
paras: 受惠費城半導體指數勁揚帶動，台股今(7)日由電子權值領漲重返4萬7千點大關，台股ETF表現同步強勢，指標ETF 0050上漲1.85%，距新高僅不到2%漲幅；持有台積電逾6成的富邦科技(0052-TW)亦上漲1.67%；科技 ETF 股王 0053 則大漲 1.91%，表現最為亮眼。
權王台積電(2330-TW)7日上漲2.07%，其他科技權值漲勢更勝，包括聯發科(2454-TW)大漲7.81%、日月光投控(3711-TW)大漲5.61%，聯電(2303-TW)更飆漲停，近期宣布將進行分割的科技市值型ETF股王0053表現強勢，加上7日漲幅後，今年以來上漲76.2%、7月底反彈20.1%，均在相對高含積量0052的72.4%、17.4%之上。
法人指出，美國大型雲端服務供應商(CSP)第二季財報表現優於預期，進一步驗證AI投資與應用需求持續擴張，且資本支出增速未見放緩，直接有利AI硬體供應鏈上中下游台廠，且兆元權值股漲勢不亞於中小股，包括市值7.6兆聯發科上漲232.9%、4.8兆台達電(2308-TW)上漲92.1%、2.8兆日月光上漲147.9%。
市場普遍看好AI帶來的生產力提升與產業轉型效益，將帶動台灣科技產業成長的重要動能，帶動資金重新聚焦半導體與AI供應鏈相關族群。
法人分析，0053為台灣唯一科技市值型ETF，成分股長期跟隨台灣科技產業脈動汰舊換新，完整覆蓋台灣兆元級科技權值股，前15大持股市值均超過兆元。隨著AI行情由晶片代工擴散至供應鏈全面受惠，除了台積電外，各產業代表公司股價成長也有所表現。
0053近期將啟動分割作業，預計以1拆7方式進行分割，分割後股價可望回到接近發行價水準，有助提升投資便利性，吸引更多投資人參與台灣科技產業長期成長契機。

paras_en: Benefiting from the strong rally in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, Taiwan's main board rose today (the 7th) led by electronics heavyweights, retaking the 47,000‑point level. Taiwan stock ETFs performed similarly strong, with the benchmark ETF 0050 up 1.85%, just under a 2% gain from its recent high; Fubon Technology (0052‑TW), which holds more than 60% TSMC, also rose 1.67%; the tech‑sector ETF leader 0053 surged 1.91%, delivering the most impressive performance.

TSMC (2330‑TW), the heavyweight of the sector, climbed 2.07% on the 7th, while other tech heavyweights posted even stronger gains, including MediaTek (2454‑TW) up 7.81%, ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) up 5.61%, and UMC (2303‑TW) hitting the daily limit. The market‑cap‑focused tech ETF leader 0053, which recently announced a split, performed robustly; after its 7th‑day gain, it is up 76.2% year‑to‑date and rebounded 20.1% at the end of July, both figures exceeding those of the relatively high‑volume 0052 at 72.4% and 17.4% respectively.

Institutions noted that U.S. large cloud service providers (CSPs) delivered second‑quarter earnings better than expected, further confirming that AI investment and application demand continue to expand and that capital‑expenditure growth has not slowed. This directly benefits the AI hardware supply chain across Taiwan, from upstream to downstream, and the surge in trillion‑NTD‑weight stocks is comparable to that of mid‑ and small‑caps, including the 7.6‑trillion‑NTD MediaTek, which rose 232.9%, the 4.8‑trillion‑NTD Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) up 92.1%, and the 2.8‑trillion‑NTD ASE Technology up 147.9%.

The market broadly views AI‑driven productivity gains and industry transformation as key drivers of growth for Taiwan’s technology sector, prompting capital to refocus on semiconductor and AI‑related supply‑chain stocks.

Analysts explain that 0053 is Taiwan’s only tech‑focused market‑cap ETF, whose constituents continuously track the evolution of the island’s technology industry, replacing old stocks with new ones and fully covering trillion‑NTD‑level tech heavyweights. The top 15 holdings each exceed a trillion NTD in market value. As the AI rally spreads from chip foundries to the entire supply chain, not only TSMC but also representative companies in each sub‑industry have shown price appreciation.

0053 will soon commence a stock split, planned as a 1‑for‑7 split. Post‑split, the share price is expected to return close to its original issue price, improving investment accessibility and attracting more investors to participate in Taiwan’s long‑term tech growth opportunity.

items.title: 樺漢8月營收創同期高 Physical AI營收將大幅提升
items.title_en: Advantech's August Revenue Hits Same-Period High; Physical AI Revenue to Surge
paras: 工業電腦大廠樺漢(6414-TW)今(7)日公告8月營收154.9 億元，月減 5.6%、年增 43.1%，累計前8月營收 1171.8 億元，年增 29.4%，雙創歷史同期新高。
樺漢表示，截至目前，集團在手訂單金額超過2,550 億元，涵蓋工業物聯網、智慧軟體與方案，以及智慧工廠與廠務等業務領域，且完成 Kontron 公開收購增加持股後，Physical AI 營收與獲利貢獻亦將大幅提升，為未來營運提供穩定能見度與成長基礎。
8月營收表現來看，樺漢說明，三大事業皆呈現成長，工業物聯網業務受惠於全球實體 AI 應用解決方案等強勁需求，營收呈現強勁雙位數增長；智慧軟體與方案受惠於長期產業增長趨勢，營收亦呈現雙位數增長。智慧工廠與廠務則持續受惠於半導體高科技廠務工程進度推進，帶動客製化設備研發製造及自動化供應系統等業務成長，營收呈現強勁雙位數年增長。
樺漢表示，將持續提升 AI、軟體與解決方案業務占比，透過自主研發、策略聯盟及併購整合，擴大高附加價值業務規模。隨著全球企業加速導入 AI 與智慧化應用，集團可望受惠於 Physical AI 與產業 AI 市場長期成長趨勢，持續優化營收結構與獲利品質，推動企業價值長期成長。
樺漢強調，憑藉集團在工業電腦、邊緣運算、工業軟體、系統整合及全球製造服務的完整布局，已建立從 AI 基礎設施、Edge AI 到 Physical AI 解決方案的完整價值鏈，並持續深化 ESaaS 發展策略，整合集團全球技術與產業資源，協助客戶推動數位轉型與智慧化升級。
paras_en: Advantech (6414-TW) announced today (the 7th) that its August revenue was NT$15.49 billion, down 5.6% month‑over‑month but up 43.1% year‑over‑year, and that cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$117.18 billion, a 29.4% annual increase, both setting historic highs for the same period.

The company said that, to date, the group holds more than NT$255 billion in orders covering industrial IoT, smart software and solutions, as well as smart factories and plant operations. After completing Kontron’s public acquisition to increase its stake, revenue and profit contributions from Physical AI are expected to rise sharply, providing stable visibility and a growth foundation for future operations.

Looking at August’s performance, Advantech explained that all three major business segments grew. The industrial IoT segment benefited from strong demand for global physical‑AI application solutions, delivering robust double‑digit revenue growth. Smart software and solutions, buoyed by long‑term industry expansion, also posted double‑digit growth. The smart factory and plant‑operations segment continued to gain from the progress of high‑tech semiconductor plant projects, driving custom equipment R&D, manufacturing and automated supply‑system businesses, resulting in strong double‑digit year‑over‑year revenue growth.

Advantech said it will keep increasing the share of AI, software and solution businesses by expanding high‑value‑added operations through in‑house R&D, strategic alliances and acquisitions. As enterprises worldwide accelerate AI and intelligent‑application adoption, the group expects to benefit from the long‑term growth of the Physical AI and industrial AI markets, continuously optimizing its revenue mix and profit quality to drive long‑term corporate value growth.

Advantech emphasized that, leveraging its comprehensive footprint in industrial computers, edge computing, industrial software, system integration and global manufacturing services, it has built a full value chain from AI infrastructure and Edge AI to Physical AI solutions. The company is deepening its ESaaS development strategy, integrating global technology and industry resources to help customers advance digital transformation and intelligent upgrades.

items.title: 雷笛克車用與 AI Server精密結構件出貨放量 8月營收1.3億元攻21個月新高
items.title_en: Leidike Automotive and AI Server Precision Components Shipments Surge, August Revenue Hits NT$130 Million, a 21‑Month High
paras: 雷笛克光學(5230-TW)今(7)日公布8月營收1.3億元，受惠車用與 AI Server零件出貨放量，呈月年雙增，並創歷年同期次高；累計前8月營收9.2億元，較去年同期成長8.4％，亦創歷年同期次高。
雷笛克光學8月營收1.3億元，月增3.22％、年增20.42％；累計前8月營收達9.2億元，較去年同期成長8.4％。
雷笛克表示，8月營收呈現月、年雙增，並改寫歷年同期次高佳績，主要受惠多項車用領域相關專案陸續於下半年步入量產放量階段，帶動車用光學透鏡出貨銷售維持年增態勢；另一方面，AI Server精密結構件隨著客戶重啟拉貨，出貨動能明顯回升，並已連續3個月呈現逐月成長，挹注公司整體營收規模持續擴大。
雷笛克指出，從目前在手訂單結構來看，截至8月車用照明領域訂單占比已達66％，高於去年同期的57％，凸顯公司近年深化車用光學透鏡市場布局、持續提高高附加價值產品占比，隨著多項車用新專案陸續量產，正逐步反映於接單及出貨表現。
同時，AI Server精密結構件客戶拉貨需求亦持續增溫，皆有助於進一步優化公司產品及應用領域布局，為後續營運成長增添動能。
展望2026年下半年，雷笛克持審慎樂觀看法。目前車用光學透鏡出貨動能延續，多項車用專案於下半年陸續進入放量階段，可望持續挹注車用業務成長；AI Server精密結構件則受惠客戶拉貨需求回升，預期9月出貨表現仍將優於8月，有助於帶動未來營運動能。
除此之外，雷笛克仍積極掌握車用照明高階化、智慧化及AI Server市場發展契機，透過新案量產、產品組合優化及深化客戶合作，以期未來營運保持成長態勢。
paras_en: Leidike Optical (5230‑TW) announced today that its August revenue reached NT$130 million, driven by increased shipments of automotive and AI server parts, showing both month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year growth and marking the second‑highest figure for the same period in company history. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months was NT$920 million, up 8.4% from a year earlier, also the second‑highest for the same period on record.

In August, Leidike Optical posted revenue of NT$130 million, up 3.22% from the previous month and 20.42% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$920 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 8.4%.

The company said the double‑digit growth in August rewrote its historical second‑best performance, mainly thanks to several automotive‑related projects entering mass production in the second half of the year, which kept automotive optical lens shipments on an upward trajectory. Meanwhile, AI server precision structures saw a clear rebound as customers resumed pulling inventory, delivering three consecutive months of month‑over‑month growth and further expanding overall revenue scale.

Leidike noted that, based on its current order book, automotive lighting orders accounted for 66% of total orders as of August, up from 57% a year earlier, highlighting the firm’s recent deepening of its automotive optical lens market presence and the rising share of high‑value‑added products. As more automotive projects move into production, this is gradually reflected in order intake and shipments.

At the same time, demand from AI server precision‑structure customers continues to warm, helping further refine the company’s product and application portfolio and adding momentum for future operational growth.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Leidike maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook. Ongoing momentum in automotive optical lens shipments and the rollout of multiple automotive projects into volume production are expected to sustain growth in the automotive segment, while revived pull‑in demand for AI server precision structures should make September shipments better than August’s, boosting future operational drive.

In addition, the company remains proactive in capturing opportunities from the premiumization and smartification of automotive lighting as well as the development of the AI server market, leveraging new mass‑production projects, product‑mix optimization, and deeper customer collaborations to sustain its growth trajectory.

items.title: 久舜8月營收3.1億元登頂年增89% 毛利較佳個案H2接續認列
items.title_en: Jiu Shun's August Revenue Hits NT$310 Million, Up 89% YoY; Higher-Margin Projects to Continue Recognition in H2
paras: 久舜營造(5547-TW)今(7)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收3.1億元，創新高，月增40.73%，年增89.5%，2026年1-8月營收17.46億元，年增20.86%。久舜營收已經單月營收連續5個月站穩2億元以上；毛利較佳的個案在下半年將接續認列。
久舜營造推出，目前各工地施工及營收認列均已恢復正常，除既有住宅與社宅統包工程穩定推進外，廠辦工程及南部地區業務亦同步貢獻營收，帶動整體營運動能進一步轉強。且久舜公司以品牌建商住宅、社宅統包、廠辦商辦及都更危老全案管理為布局主軸，案源確定性與營收能見度較高，可降低房市短期波動影響。

同時，國家住都中心8月公布中央社宅第三季釋出1,500戶招租，政府推動社宅政策方向不變；久舜已承攬頂埔安居、永福好室、福安安居及桃園A21等統包案，此類工程具單案金額大、工期長、認列穩定等特性，為中長期營運基本盤。同時，行政院7月通過都更及危老條例修正草案，刪除危老重建申請期限使制度常態化，並新增自主更新全案管理與信用保證機制，預計立法院9月新會期排審；若完成修法，可望降低地主整合與融資障礙，擴大專業全案管理服務需求。

久舜指出，全台屋齡逾30年住宅已突破500萬戶、約占全體住宅成，但北台灣逾8成已核定的都更危老案因施工成本上漲遲遲無法開工，地主普遍面臨重建條件認知不足、擔憂權益受損與資金調度困難三大障礙。旗下久聯建築即以建築經理及都更危老全案管理為核心，提供前期規劃、資金信託、履約管理、工程發包及都更推動諮詢，並以「快速重建、利潤回饋屋主」為服務主軸，確保重建資金專款專用；搭配「不與地主分屋、以管理費及營造服務費為主要收入」的委建模式，可有效降低地主對權益分配與資金安全的疑慮，形成「前期全案管理服務搭配後續營造工程承攬」的雙層收入結構，也使久舜成為少數由甲級營造廠起家、能一路做到全案維運管理的業者。北投大業都更案目前已完成拆屋並進入開工準備，預計2027年上半年開始挹注營收，將是此一模式落地的重要實績。
久舜2026年上半年營收12.15億元，毛利率11.5%，稅後純益5484萬元，每股純益1.1元。
paras_en: Jiu Shun Construction (5547-TW) today (7th) announced its latest revenue figures: August 2026 revenue was NT$310 million, a record high, up 40.73% month‑on‑month and 89.5% year‑on‑year. For January‑August 2026, revenue totaled NT$1.746 billion, up 20.86% YoY. Jiu Shun's monthly revenue has stayed above NT$200 million for five consecutive months; higher‑margin projects will continue to be recognized in the second half of the year.

Jiu Shun Construction reports that construction activities and revenue recognition at all sites have returned to normal. In addition to stable progress on existing residential and public‑housing turnkey projects, factory‑office projects and business in southern Taiwan are also contributing revenue, further strengthening overall operational momentum. The company’s core strategy focuses on brand‑name residential building, public‑housing turnkey, factory‑office commercial projects and full‑cycle urban renewal and unsafe‑building management, which provides high case certainty and revenue visibility, helping to mitigate short‑term housing‑market fluctuations.

At the same time, the National Housing and Urban Development Center announced in August that the Central Government’s public‑housing program will release 1,500 units for rent in Q3, keeping the policy direction unchanged. Jiu Shun has secured turnkey projects such as Dingpu Anju, Yongfu Haoshi, Fu’an Anju and Taoyuan A21; these projects feature large single‑project values, long construction periods and stable revenue recognition, forming the backbone of its mid‑ to long‑term operations. Moreover, the Executive Yuan passed a draft amendment to the Urban Renewal and Unsafe Building Act in July, removing the deadline for unsafe‑building reconstruction applications to make the system routine, and adding a self‑initiated full‑cycle management and credit‑guarantee mechanism, which is slated for Legislative Yuan review in the new session starting September. If the amendment is enacted, it is expected to reduce landowner integration and financing obstacles, expanding demand for professional full‑cycle management services.

Jiu Shun points out that there are now over 5 million residential units in Taiwan that are more than 30 years old, accounting for about ___ of all housing. In northern Taiwan, more than 80 % of approved urban‑renewal unsafe‑building cases have stalled because rising construction costs prevent them from breaking ground. Landowners generally face three major hurdles: insufficient understanding of reconstruction conditions, concerns over rights erosion, and difficulty in financing. Its subsidiary Jiu Lian Construction focuses on construction management and full‑cycle unsafe‑building renewal, offering pre‑project planning, fund‑trust services, performance management, engineering contracting and renewal consulting, and operates under the service principle of “fast reconstruction, profit sharing with homeowners” to ensure reconstruction funds are used exclusively for that purpose. Coupled with a “no‑share‑with‑landowner, management‑fee and construction‑service‑fee as main revenue”委建 model, it effectively alleviates landowner concerns about rights allocation and fund safety, creating a dual‑layer revenue structure of “pre‑project full‑cycle management plus subsequent construction contracting.” This makes Jiu Shun one of the few firms that started as a Class‑A contractor and now provides end‑to‑end project operation management. The Beitou Daye urban‑renewal project has completed demolition and is preparing to start construction, with revenue expected to begin flowing in the first half of 2027, serving as a key proof‑of‑concept for this model.
In the first half of 2026, Jiu Shun recorded revenue of NT$1.215 billion, a gross margin of 11.5%, net profit after tax of NT$54.84 million, and earnings per share of NT$1.1.

items.title: 群光8月營收65.2億元 影像產品切入美系機器人供應鏈
items.title_en: Qun Guang Reports NT$6.52 Billion Revenue in August, Image Products Enter U.S. Robotics Supply Chain
paras: 群光(2385-TW)今(7)日公布8月營收65.2億元，呈年月雙減。累計今年前8月合併營收588.38億元，年減8.5%；群光同步公告，獨家切入美國知名機器人新創大廠的供應鏈。群光將為其量身打造核心影像與數據收集設備，扮演機器人的「視覺與感知樞紐」。
群光8月營收新台幣65.2億元，月減7.6%，年減23%。累計前8月營收588.4億元，年減8.5%。群光表示，近期因原物料成本上漲以及關鍵半導體料件缺貨影響，客戶需求普遍遲緩，但商用機種的需求仍較消費性機種穩健，為群光出貨重心。
群光同時宣布獨家切入美國知名機器人新創大廠的供應鏈，預計最快明年出貨，有望貢獻營收。群光已積極將研發重心移向高附加價值的「邊緣 AI 視覺方案」，成功融合視覺語言模型與多感測深度學習技術。已在智慧安防、車隊管理、視訊會議及穿戴式裝置等利基市場奠定穩固基礎，如今跨足機器人數據收集與感知裝備領域。
群光表示，透過在機器人身上布建多鏡頭數據收集系統，群光能賦予設備強大的環境判讀與動態記錄能力，大幅優化數據採集的品質，進而提升機械手臂在細微操作與精密力道控制上的訓練表現。成為「實體 AI」發展關鍵的數據推進器。
paras_en: Qun Guang (2385-TW) announced today (the 7th) that its August revenue was NT$6.52 billion, showing declines both month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year. Cumulative consolidated revenue for the first eight months of this year reached NT$58.838 billion, down 8.5% year‑over‑year. The company also disclosed that it has uniquely entered the supply chain of a well‑known U.S. robotics startup, where it will custom‑design core imaging and data‑collection equipment to serve as the robot’s “visual and perception hub.”

In August, Qun Guang’s revenue of NT$6.52 billion fell 7.6% from the prior month and 23% from a year earlier. The cumulative revenue for the first eight months stood at NT$58.84 billion, an 8.5% year‑over‑year decline. The company said that recent increases in raw‑material costs and shortages of key semiconductor components have slowed overall customer demand, although demand for commercial‑grade models remains steadier than for consumer models, which continues to be the focus of Qun Guang’s shipments.

Qun Guang also announced its exclusive entry into the supply chain of a prominent U.S. robotics startup, with shipments expected as early as next year and the potential to boost revenue. The firm has been shifting R&D toward high‑value‑added “edge AI vision solutions,” successfully integrating visual language models with multi‑sensor deep‑learning technologies. It has already built a solid foothold in niche markets such as smart security, fleet management, video conferencing, and wearable devices, and is now expanding into robot data‑collection and perception equipment.

Qun Guang explained that by installing multi‑camera data‑collection systems on robots, it can endow the devices with powerful environmental interpretation and dynamic recording capabilities, greatly improving the quality of data acquisition. This, in turn, enhances the training performance of robotic arms in fine‑grained operations and precise force control, positioning Qun Guang as a key data driver for the development of “physical AI.”

items.title: 受惠部分遞延CDMO訂單完成出貨 保瑞8月營收21.8億元創單月歷史次高
items.title_en: Benefiting from Deferred CDMO Orders Completed Shipment, Baorui's August Revenue Hits NT$2.18 Billion, a Record Monthly High
paras: 保瑞(6472-TW)今(7)日公告8月營收21.85億元，年增近6成，創歷史次高紀錄。保瑞指出，7月因客戶拉貨排程調整而遞延的部分CDMO訂單，已於8月完成出貨，加上加拿大廠、馬里蘭州無菌針劑廠及生物製劑CDMO Rockville廠貢獻，推升動能回溫。
保瑞旗下CDMO子公司保盛藥業董事會今天通過中壢二廠不動產售後租回案，出售價金為8.5億元，將依市場行情向買方回租5年，並指出既有生產與營運不受影響。
針對此交易，保瑞表示，透過此次交易，將原有不動產持有及融資成本轉換為市場價值，並預計認列瘀1.14億元資產處分利益，未來每年回租費用由具高獲利能力營運主體承擔，有助提升長期租稅效益，預期每年可穩定產生約1655萬元的淨利及現金流。
其他業務方面，全球銷售業務上，旗下Upsher-Smith專科品牌藥旗艦產品線Vigabatrin三種劑型8月營業額再創歷史新高。
消費者保健事業上，子公司晨暉生技(1271-TW)新併購的Weider Global Nutrition(威德)目前處於9、10月零售傳統旺季前的備貨與銷售轉換期，短期營運將呈現「先蹲後跳」，隨美國零售旺季逐步到來，營收成長可期。
paras_en: Baorui (6472-TW) announced today that its August revenue reached NT$2.185 billion, up nearly 60% year‑over‑year, marking a historic second‑highest monthly record. The company said that CDMO orders postponed in July due to customers adjusting pull‑in schedules were shipped in August, and contributions from its Canadian plant, a sterile injectable facility in Maryland, and the Rockville biologics CDMO plant boosted momentum.

August revenue was NT$2.185 billion, up 14.88% month‑over‑month and 59.22% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year reached NT$13.978 billion, a 6.09% increase year‑over‑year.

Baorui’s CDMO subsidiary Baosheng Pharmaceutical’s board approved today a sale‑and‑lease‑back of its Zhongli Plant 2 real‑estate for NT$850 million. The property will be leased back for five years at market rates, and the company said existing production and operations will not be affected.

Regarding the transaction, Baorui said it will convert the owned real‑estate and financing costs into market value, expecting to recognize a NT$114 million gain on disposal. Future lease payments will be borne by a highly profitable operating entity, improving long‑term tax efficiency and generating an estimated stable net profit and cash flow of about NT$16.55 million per year.
In other business areas, global sales saw the flagship product line of its Upsher‑Smith specialty brand, Vigabatrin, achieve a new historical high in August across three dosage forms.

In the consumer health segment, subsidiary Chenhui Biotech (1271‑TW) recently acquired Weider Global Nutrition (Weider). The new unit is currently in a stocking and sales‑transition phase ahead of the September‑October retail peak season, so short‑term operations will be “quiet first, then surge.” Revenue growth is expected as the U.S. retail peak unfolds.

items.title: 凱基證完成193億元聯合授信案 7家金融機構參與
items.title_en: KGI Securities Completes NT$19.3 Billion Syndicated Loan with 7 Financial Institutions
paras: 凱基證券與第一商業銀行和銀行團於今(7)日完成3年期新台幣193億元聯合授信案簽約，凱基證說明，此主要支應中期營運週轉金需求，獲得銀行團支持，不僅為未來營運發展提供充足資金，更展現金融同業對凱基證長期發展策略與經營成果的高度認同。
本案由第一商業銀行、臺灣銀行、兆豐國際商業銀行和華南商業銀行統籌主辦，彰化商業銀行擔任共同主辦銀行，並邀集台灣中小企業銀行和樂天國際商業銀行參貸，共計7家金融機構參與。
凱基證說明，聯貸資金到位後，將有助強化資金調度彈性及優化資金籌措結構，支應各項業務發展、海內外市場布局需求，進一步提升整體經營韌性與競爭力。
面對全球金融市場快速變化與投資需求持續升級，凱基證強調，將持續深化核心業務競爭優勢，推動數位金融創新服務，並積極推動永續金融與區域市場布局。
paras_en: KGI Securities and First Commercial Bank, together with a banking consortium, signed a three‑year NT$19.3 billion syndicated loan agreement today (the 7th). KGI explained that the facility mainly meets mid‑term operating working‑capital needs; backed by the consortium, it not only provides ample funding for future operational development but also reflects strong industry recognition of KGI’s long‑term strategy and performance.

The transaction is coordinated and led by First Commercial Bank, Bank of Taiwan, Mega International Commercial Bank and Hua Nan Commercial Bank, with Changhua Commercial Bank serving as co‑lead bank, and invites Taiwan SME Bank and Rakuten International Commercial Bank to participate, bringing the total to seven financial institutions.

KGI said that once the syndicated funds are in place, they will help strengthen cash‑flow flexibility and optimise the financing structure, support various business development and domestic and overseas market expansion needs, and further enhance overall operational resilience and competitiveness.

Facing rapid changes in global financial markets and continuously rising investment demand, KGI emphasized it will keep deepening its core business competitive advantages, promote digital financial‑innovation services, and actively advance sustainable finance and regional market expansion.

items.title: 穎崴擴產效益逐步顯 8月營收17億元飆新高
items.title_en: Winstar Expands Production Benefits Gradually, August Revenue Hits New High of 17.06 Billion TWD
paras: 測試介面大廠穎崴科技(6515-TW)今(7)日公告8月營收達17.06億元，月增6.58%，年增233.37%，累計今年前8月營收為98.1億元，較去年同期增加97.88%。受惠AI應用訂單持續帶動，穎崴8月營收創下單月歷史新高，不僅為連5月單月營收月增，更締造連3月單月營收創新高紀錄，累計前8月營收優於預期；面對全球AI客戶對高階測試迫切需求，穎崴迅速擴充產能，寫下連三個月業績創高佳績。
SEMICON TAIWAN 2026甫落幕，延續去年主軸，先進封裝今年持續領銜，產業地位從後段製程進階為系統整合，其中，在3DIC論壇公布3DIC先進封裝製造聯盟未來三年方向，並推動矽產業協同優化(STCO, Silicon-Technology Co-Optimization)，大會明確指引透過合作與聯盟，加速先進封裝生態系。
SEMICON TAIWAN此次也首度舉行「AI時代半導體測試與量測產業洞察暨倡議記者會」，共同探討AI晶片爆發下測試與量測產業面臨的關鍵轉折。先進封裝複雜度持續帶動測試設備及測試介面商機，穎崴「次世代先進測試介面平台」亦同步升級，尤其次世代超導測試座HyperSocket透過獨創導電膠架構，為先進封裝世代下大封裝、高電流、高針數等測試極限挑戰的最佳解決方案。

近期穎崴於《Advancedpackaging》期刊發表最新技術相關文章「OE的多樣性：CPO的量產關鍵瓶頸(Optical engine fragmentation: The critical bottleneck to CPO volume production)」，探討光學引擎規格的多樣性帶來CPO當前的百花齊放，同時指出未來隨著業界收斂光學引擎規格，才能實現具經濟效益且可量產的CPO生態系統。
近期AI科技大廠預估五大CSP業者2026年投入資料中心的支出將達8000億美元，並估2027年支出年增逾60%、達1.3兆美元；同時Hyperscaler AI基礎建設持續擴張，目前雲端業務在手訂單(Cloud industry backlog)已超過2兆美元。
AI熱潮使AI晶片需求持續增加，半導體測試供應鏈將在此趨勢下成長，穎崴長期耕耘半導體高階先進測試介面，在完整且深厚研發能量及全球技術支援布局下，從早期產品設計階段便與客戶共同開發，因此能兼顧效能與客戶需求，並滿足KGD (Known Good Die)的測試需求，提供客戶完整的一站式解決方案。
paras_en: Test‑interface giant Winstar Technology (6515‑TW) announced today (the 7th) that its August revenue reached NT$17.06 billion, up 6.58% month‑over‑month and 233.37% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months of this year was NT$98.1 billion, a 97.88% increase over the same period last year. Driven by continued AI‑application orders, August revenue set a single‑month historical high, marking the fifth consecutive month of month‑over‑month growth and the third straight month of record‑high single‑month revenue, with the first‑eight‑month total exceeding expectations. Facing strong global AI customer demand for high‑end testing, Winstar rapidly expanded capacity, achieving three consecutive months of record performance.

SEMICON TAIWAN 2026 has just concluded, continuing last year’s focus with advanced packaging leading the way this year. The industry’s position has moved from back‑end processing to system integration. At the 3DIC forum, the 3DIC Advanced Packaging Manufacturing Alliance unveiled its three‑year roadmap and promoted silicon‑industry co‑optimization (STCO). The conference clearly directed that cooperation and alliances should accelerate the advanced‑packaging ecosystem.

SEMICON TAIWAN also held, for the first time, an “AI‑Era Semiconductor Test and Measurement Industry Insight & Initiative Press Conference,” jointly discussing the critical turning points the test and measurement sector faces amid the AI‑chip boom. The growing complexity of advanced packaging continues to drive opportunities for test equipment and test‑interface providers. Winstar’s “next‑generation advanced test‑interface platform” is being upgraded in tandem, especially its next‑generation superconducting test socket, HyperSocket, which uses a proprietary conductive‑gel architecture to address the extreme testing challenges of large‑scale packages, high current and high pin‑count in the advanced‑packaging era.

Recently, Winstar published a technical article in the journal Advanced Packaging titled “Diversity of OEs: The Critical Bottleneck to CPO Volume Production (Optical Engine Fragmentation: The Critical Bottleneck to CPO Volume Production).” The paper examines how the variety of optical‑engine specifications has led to a proliferation of CPO designs today, and argues that industry convergence on optical‑engine specs will be necessary to achieve an economically viable, mass‑produced CPO ecosystem.

Recent estimates from major AI‑technology firms project that the five largest cloud‑service providers will spend US$800 billion on data‑center investments in 2026, with 2027 spending expected to grow over 60% year‑over‑year to US$1.3 trillion. Meanwhile, hyperscaler AI infrastructure continues to expand, and the cloud‑industry backlog now exceeds US$2 trillion.

The AI wave is driving sustained growth in AI‑chip demand, and the semiconductor test supply chain is set to expand with this trend. Winstar has long cultivated high‑end advanced test‑interface capabilities; with deep R&D resources and a global technical support network, it collaborates with customers from early product‑design stages, balancing performance with customer needs and meeting Known Good Die (KGD) testing requirements, thereby delivering a complete one‑stop solution.

items.title: 權值軍團發威！0053分割前夕飆漲近2% 0050逼近新高
items.title_en: Weight‑class Titans Surge! 0053 Jumps Nearly 2% Ahead of Split, 0050 Near New High
paras: 受惠費城半導體指數勁揚帶動，台股今(7)日由電子權值領漲重返4萬7千點大關，台股ETF表現同步強勢，指標ETF 0050上漲1.85%，距新高僅不到2%漲幅；持有台積電逾6成的富邦科技(0052-TW)亦上漲1.67%；科技 ETF 股王 0053 則大漲 1.91%，表現最為亮眼。
權王台積電(2330-TW)7日上漲2.07%，其他科技權值漲勢更勝，包括聯發科(2454-TW)大漲7.81%、日月光投控(3711-TW)大漲5.61%，聯電(2303-TW)更飆漲停，近期宣布將進行分割的科技市值型ETF股王0053表現強勢，加上7日漲幅後，今年以來上漲76.2%、7月底反彈20.1%，均在相對高含積量0052的72.4%、17.4%之上。
法人指出，美國大型雲端服務供應商(CSP)第二季財報表現優於預期，進一步驗證AI投資與應用需求持續擴張，且資本支出增速未見放緩，直接有利AI硬體供應鏈上中下游台廠，且兆元權值股漲勢不亞於中小股，包括市值7.6兆聯發科上漲232.9%、4.8兆台達電(2308-TW)上漲92.1%、2.8兆日月光上漲147.9%。
市場普遍看好AI帶來的生產力提升與產業轉型效益，將帶動台灣科技產業成長的重要動能，帶動資金重新聚焦半導體與AI供應鏈相關族群。
法人分析，0053為台灣唯一科技市值型ETF，成分股長期跟隨台灣科技產業脈動汰舊換新，完整覆蓋台灣兆元級科技權值股，前15大持股市值均超過兆元。隨著AI行情由晶片代工擴散至供應鏈全面受惠，除了台積電外，各產業代表公司股價成長也有所表現。
0053近期將啟動分割作業，預計以1拆7方式進行分割，分割後股價可望回到接近發行價水準，有助提升投資便利性，吸引更多投資人參與台灣科技產業長期成長契機。

paras_en: Benefiting from the strong rally in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, Taiwan's main board rose today (the 7th) led by electronics heavyweights, retaking the 47,000‑point level. Taiwan stock ETFs performed similarly strong, with the benchmark ETF 0050 up 1.85%, just under a 2% gain from its recent high; Fubon Technology (0052‑TW), which holds more than 60% TSMC, also rose 1.67%; the tech‑sector ETF leader 0053 surged 1.91%, delivering the most impressive performance.

TSMC (2330‑TW), the heavyweight of the sector, climbed 2.07% on the 7th, while other tech heavyweights posted even stronger gains, including MediaTek (2454‑TW) up 7.81%, ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) up 5.61%, and UMC (2303‑TW) hitting the daily limit. The market‑cap‑focused tech ETF leader 0053, which recently announced a split, performed robustly; after its 7th‑day gain, it is up 76.2% year‑to‑date and rebounded 20.1% at the end of July, both figures exceeding those of the relatively high‑volume 0052 at 72.4% and 17.4% respectively.

Institutions noted that U.S. large cloud service providers (CSPs) delivered second‑quarter earnings better than expected, further confirming that AI investment and application demand continue to expand and that capital‑expenditure growth has not slowed. This directly benefits the AI hardware supply chain across Taiwan, from upstream to downstream, and the surge in trillion‑NTD‑weight stocks is comparable to that of mid‑ and small‑caps, including the 7.6‑trillion‑NTD MediaTek, which rose 232.9%, the 4.8‑trillion‑NTD Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) up 92.1%, and the 2.8‑trillion‑NTD ASE Technology up 147.9%.

The market broadly views AI‑driven productivity gains and industry transformation as key drivers of growth for Taiwan’s technology sector, prompting capital to refocus on semiconductor and AI‑related supply‑chain stocks.

Analysts explain that 0053 is Taiwan’s only tech‑focused market‑cap ETF, whose constituents continuously track the evolution of the island’s technology industry, replacing old stocks with new ones and fully covering trillion‑NTD‑level tech heavyweights. The top 15 holdings each exceed a trillion NTD in market value. As the AI rally spreads from chip foundries to the entire supply chain, not only TSMC but also representative companies in each sub‑industry have shown price appreciation.

0053 will soon commence a stock split, planned as a 1‑for‑7 split. Post‑split, the share price is expected to return close to its original issue price, improving investment accessibility and attracting more investors to participate in Taiwan’s long‑term tech growth opportunity.
