items.title: 樺漢8月營收創同期高 Physical AI營收將大幅提升
items.title_en: Advantech's August Revenue Hits Same-Period High; Physical AI Revenue to Surge
paras: 工業電腦大廠樺漢(6414-TW)今(7)日公告8月營收154.9 億元，月減 5.6%、年增 43.1%，累計前8月營收 1171.8 億元，年增 29.4%，雙創歷史同期新高。
樺漢表示，截至目前，集團在手訂單金額超過2,550 億元，涵蓋工業物聯網、智慧軟體與方案，以及智慧工廠與廠務等業務領域，且完成 Kontron 公開收購增加持股後，Physical AI 營收與獲利貢獻亦將大幅提升，為未來營運提供穩定能見度與成長基礎。
8月營收表現來看，樺漢說明，三大事業皆呈現成長，工業物聯網業務受惠於全球實體 AI 應用解決方案等強勁需求，營收呈現強勁雙位數增長；智慧軟體與方案受惠於長期產業增長趨勢，營收亦呈現雙位數增長。智慧工廠與廠務則持續受惠於半導體高科技廠務工程進度推進，帶動客製化設備研發製造及自動化供應系統等業務成長，營收呈現強勁雙位數年增長。
樺漢表示，將持續提升 AI、軟體與解決方案業務占比，透過自主研發、策略聯盟及併購整合，擴大高附加價值業務規模。隨著全球企業加速導入 AI 與智慧化應用，集團可望受惠於 Physical AI 與產業 AI 市場長期成長趨勢，持續優化營收結構與獲利品質，推動企業價值長期成長。
樺漢強調，憑藉集團在工業電腦、邊緣運算、工業軟體、系統整合及全球製造服務的完整布局，已建立從 AI 基礎設施、Edge AI 到 Physical AI 解決方案的完整價值鏈，並持續深化 ESaaS 發展策略，整合集團全球技術與產業資源，協助客戶推動數位轉型與智慧化升級。
paras_en: Advantech (6414-TW) announced today (the 7th) that its August revenue was NT$15.49 billion, down 5.6% month‑over‑month but up 43.1% year‑over‑year, and that cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$117.18 billion, a 29.4% annual increase, both setting historic highs for the same period.

The company said that, to date, the group holds more than NT$255 billion in orders covering industrial IoT, smart software and solutions, as well as smart factories and plant operations. After completing Kontron’s public acquisition to increase its stake, revenue and profit contributions from Physical AI are expected to rise sharply, providing stable visibility and a growth foundation for future operations.

Looking at August’s performance, Advantech explained that all three major business segments grew. The industrial IoT segment benefited from strong demand for global physical‑AI application solutions, delivering robust double‑digit revenue growth. Smart software and solutions, buoyed by long‑term industry expansion, also posted double‑digit growth. The smart factory and plant‑operations segment continued to gain from the progress of high‑tech semiconductor plant projects, driving custom equipment R&D, manufacturing and automated supply‑system businesses, resulting in strong double‑digit year‑over‑year revenue growth.

Advantech said it will keep increasing the share of AI, software and solution businesses by expanding high‑value‑added operations through in‑house R&D, strategic alliances and acquisitions. As enterprises worldwide accelerate AI and intelligent‑application adoption, the group expects to benefit from the long‑term growth of the Physical AI and industrial AI markets, continuously optimizing its revenue mix and profit quality to drive long‑term corporate value growth.

Advantech emphasized that, leveraging its comprehensive footprint in industrial computers, edge computing, industrial software, system integration and global manufacturing services, it has built a full value chain from AI infrastructure and Edge AI to Physical AI solutions. The company is deepening its ESaaS development strategy, integrating global technology and industry resources to help customers advance digital transformation and intelligent upgrades.

items.title: 雷笛克車用與 AI Server精密結構件出貨放量 8月營收1.3億元攻21個月新高
items.title_en: Leidike Automotive and AI Server Precision Components Shipments Surge, August Revenue Hits NT$130 Million, a 21‑Month High
paras: 雷笛克光學(5230-TW)今(7)日公布8月營收1.3億元，受惠車用與 AI Server零件出貨放量，呈月年雙增，並創歷年同期次高；累計前8月營收9.2億元，較去年同期成長8.4％，亦創歷年同期次高。
雷笛克光學8月營收1.3億元，月增3.22％、年增20.42％；累計前8月營收達9.2億元，較去年同期成長8.4％。
雷笛克表示，8月營收呈現月、年雙增，並改寫歷年同期次高佳績，主要受惠多項車用領域相關專案陸續於下半年步入量產放量階段，帶動車用光學透鏡出貨銷售維持年增態勢；另一方面，AI Server精密結構件隨著客戶重啟拉貨，出貨動能明顯回升，並已連續3個月呈現逐月成長，挹注公司整體營收規模持續擴大。
雷笛克指出，從目前在手訂單結構來看，截至8月車用照明領域訂單占比已達66％，高於去年同期的57％，凸顯公司近年深化車用光學透鏡市場布局、持續提高高附加價值產品占比，隨著多項車用新專案陸續量產，正逐步反映於接單及出貨表現。
同時，AI Server精密結構件客戶拉貨需求亦持續增溫，皆有助於進一步優化公司產品及應用領域布局，為後續營運成長增添動能。
展望2026年下半年，雷笛克持審慎樂觀看法。目前車用光學透鏡出貨動能延續，多項車用專案於下半年陸續進入放量階段，可望持續挹注車用業務成長；AI Server精密結構件則受惠客戶拉貨需求回升，預期9月出貨表現仍將優於8月，有助於帶動未來營運動能。
除此之外，雷笛克仍積極掌握車用照明高階化、智慧化及AI Server市場發展契機，透過新案量產、產品組合優化及深化客戶合作，以期未來營運保持成長態勢。
paras_en: Leidike Optical (5230‑TW) announced today that its August revenue reached NT$130 million, driven by increased shipments of automotive and AI server parts, showing both month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year growth and marking the second‑highest figure for the same period in company history. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months was NT$920 million, up 8.4% from a year earlier, also the second‑highest for the same period on record.

In August, Leidike Optical posted revenue of NT$130 million, up 3.22% from the previous month and 20.42% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$920 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 8.4%.

The company said the double‑digit growth in August rewrote its historical second‑best performance, mainly thanks to several automotive‑related projects entering mass production in the second half of the year, which kept automotive optical lens shipments on an upward trajectory. Meanwhile, AI server precision structures saw a clear rebound as customers resumed pulling inventory, delivering three consecutive months of month‑over‑month growth and further expanding overall revenue scale.

Leidike noted that, based on its current order book, automotive lighting orders accounted for 66% of total orders as of August, up from 57% a year earlier, highlighting the firm’s recent deepening of its automotive optical lens market presence and the rising share of high‑value‑added products. As more automotive projects move into production, this is gradually reflected in order intake and shipments.

At the same time, demand from AI server precision‑structure customers continues to warm, helping further refine the company’s product and application portfolio and adding momentum for future operational growth.

Looking ahead to the second half of 2026, Leidike maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook. Ongoing momentum in automotive optical lens shipments and the rollout of multiple automotive projects into volume production are expected to sustain growth in the automotive segment, while revived pull‑in demand for AI server precision structures should make September shipments better than August’s, boosting future operational drive.

In addition, the company remains proactive in capturing opportunities from the premiumization and smartification of automotive lighting as well as the development of the AI server market, leveraging new mass‑production projects, product‑mix optimization, and deeper customer collaborations to sustain its growth trajectory.

items.title: 久舜8月營收3.1億元登頂年增89% 毛利較佳個案H2接續認列
items.title_en: Jiu Shun's August Revenue Hits NT$310 Million, Up 89% YoY; Higher-Margin Projects to Continue Recognition in H2
paras: 久舜營造(5547-TW)今(7)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收3.1億元，創新高，月增40.73%，年增89.5%，2026年1-8月營收17.46億元，年增20.86%。久舜營收已經單月營收連續5個月站穩2億元以上；毛利較佳的個案在下半年將接續認列。
久舜營造推出，目前各工地施工及營收認列均已恢復正常，除既有住宅與社宅統包工程穩定推進外，廠辦工程及南部地區業務亦同步貢獻營收，帶動整體營運動能進一步轉強。且久舜公司以品牌建商住宅、社宅統包、廠辦商辦及都更危老全案管理為布局主軸，案源確定性與營收能見度較高，可降低房市短期波動影響。

同時，國家住都中心8月公布中央社宅第三季釋出1,500戶招租，政府推動社宅政策方向不變；久舜已承攬頂埔安居、永福好室、福安安居及桃園A21等統包案，此類工程具單案金額大、工期長、認列穩定等特性，為中長期營運基本盤。同時，行政院7月通過都更及危老條例修正草案，刪除危老重建申請期限使制度常態化，並新增自主更新全案管理與信用保證機制，預計立法院9月新會期排審；若完成修法，可望降低地主整合與融資障礙，擴大專業全案管理服務需求。

久舜指出，全台屋齡逾30年住宅已突破500萬戶、約占全體住宅成，但北台灣逾8成已核定的都更危老案因施工成本上漲遲遲無法開工，地主普遍面臨重建條件認知不足、擔憂權益受損與資金調度困難三大障礙。旗下久聯建築即以建築經理及都更危老全案管理為核心，提供前期規劃、資金信託、履約管理、工程發包及都更推動諮詢，並以「快速重建、利潤回饋屋主」為服務主軸，確保重建資金專款專用；搭配「不與地主分屋、以管理費及營造服務費為主要收入」的委建模式，可有效降低地主對權益分配與資金安全的疑慮，形成「前期全案管理服務搭配後續營造工程承攬」的雙層收入結構，也使久舜成為少數由甲級營造廠起家、能一路做到全案維運管理的業者。北投大業都更案目前已完成拆屋並進入開工準備，預計2027年上半年開始挹注營收，將是此一模式落地的重要實績。
久舜2026年上半年營收12.15億元，毛利率11.5%，稅後純益5484萬元，每股純益1.1元。
paras_en: Jiu Shun Construction (5547-TW) today (7th) announced its latest revenue figures: August 2026 revenue was NT$310 million, a record high, up 40.73% month‑on‑month and 89.5% year‑on‑year. For January‑August 2026, revenue totaled NT$1.746 billion, up 20.86% YoY. Jiu Shun's monthly revenue has stayed above NT$200 million for five consecutive months; higher‑margin projects will continue to be recognized in the second half of the year.

Jiu Shun Construction reports that construction activities and revenue recognition at all sites have returned to normal. In addition to stable progress on existing residential and public‑housing turnkey projects, factory‑office projects and business in southern Taiwan are also contributing revenue, further strengthening overall operational momentum. The company’s core strategy focuses on brand‑name residential building, public‑housing turnkey, factory‑office commercial projects and full‑cycle urban renewal and unsafe‑building management, which provides high case certainty and revenue visibility, helping to mitigate short‑term housing‑market fluctuations.

At the same time, the National Housing and Urban Development Center announced in August that the Central Government’s public‑housing program will release 1,500 units for rent in Q3, keeping the policy direction unchanged. Jiu Shun has secured turnkey projects such as Dingpu Anju, Yongfu Haoshi, Fu’an Anju and Taoyuan A21; these projects feature large single‑project values, long construction periods and stable revenue recognition, forming the backbone of its mid‑ to long‑term operations. Moreover, the Executive Yuan passed a draft amendment to the Urban Renewal and Unsafe Building Act in July, removing the deadline for unsafe‑building reconstruction applications to make the system routine, and adding a self‑initiated full‑cycle management and credit‑guarantee mechanism, which is slated for Legislative Yuan review in the new session starting September. If the amendment is enacted, it is expected to reduce landowner integration and financing obstacles, expanding demand for professional full‑cycle management services.

Jiu Shun points out that there are now over 5 million residential units in Taiwan that are more than 30 years old, accounting for about ___ of all housing. In northern Taiwan, more than 80 % of approved urban‑renewal unsafe‑building cases have stalled because rising construction costs prevent them from breaking ground. Landowners generally face three major hurdles: insufficient understanding of reconstruction conditions, concerns over rights erosion, and difficulty in financing. Its subsidiary Jiu Lian Construction focuses on construction management and full‑cycle unsafe‑building renewal, offering pre‑project planning, fund‑trust services, performance management, engineering contracting and renewal consulting, and operates under the service principle of “fast reconstruction, profit sharing with homeowners” to ensure reconstruction funds are used exclusively for that purpose. Coupled with a “no‑share‑with‑landowner, management‑fee and construction‑service‑fee as main revenue”委建 model, it effectively alleviates landowner concerns about rights allocation and fund safety, creating a dual‑layer revenue structure of “pre‑project full‑cycle management plus subsequent construction contracting.” This makes Jiu Shun one of the few firms that started as a Class‑A contractor and now provides end‑to‑end project operation management. The Beitou Daye urban‑renewal project has completed demolition and is preparing to start construction, with revenue expected to begin flowing in the first half of 2027, serving as a key proof‑of‑concept for this model.
In the first half of 2026, Jiu Shun recorded revenue of NT$1.215 billion, a gross margin of 11.5%, net profit after tax of NT$54.84 million, and earnings per share of NT$1.1.

items.title: 群光8月營收65.2億元 影像產品切入美系機器人供應鏈
items.title_en: Qun Guang Reports NT$6.52 Billion Revenue in August, Image Products Enter U.S. Robotics Supply Chain
paras: 群光(2385-TW)今(7)日公布8月營收65.2億元，呈年月雙減。累計今年前8月合併營收588.38億元，年減8.5%；群光同步公告，獨家切入美國知名機器人新創大廠的供應鏈。群光將為其量身打造核心影像與數據收集設備，扮演機器人的「視覺與感知樞紐」。
群光8月營收新台幣65.2億元，月減7.6%，年減23%。累計前8月營收588.4億元，年減8.5%。群光表示，近期因原物料成本上漲以及關鍵半導體料件缺貨影響，客戶需求普遍遲緩，但商用機種的需求仍較消費性機種穩健，為群光出貨重心。
群光同時宣布獨家切入美國知名機器人新創大廠的供應鏈，預計最快明年出貨，有望貢獻營收。群光已積極將研發重心移向高附加價值的「邊緣 AI 視覺方案」，成功融合視覺語言模型與多感測深度學習技術。已在智慧安防、車隊管理、視訊會議及穿戴式裝置等利基市場奠定穩固基礎，如今跨足機器人數據收集與感知裝備領域。
群光表示，透過在機器人身上布建多鏡頭數據收集系統，群光能賦予設備強大的環境判讀與動態記錄能力，大幅優化數據採集的品質，進而提升機械手臂在細微操作與精密力道控制上的訓練表現。成為「實體 AI」發展關鍵的數據推進器。
paras_en: Qun Guang (2385-TW) announced today (the 7th) that its August revenue was NT$6.52 billion, showing declines both month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year. Cumulative consolidated revenue for the first eight months of this year reached NT$58.838 billion, down 8.5% year‑over‑year. The company also disclosed that it has uniquely entered the supply chain of a well‑known U.S. robotics startup, where it will custom‑design core imaging and data‑collection equipment to serve as the robot’s “visual and perception hub.”

In August, Qun Guang’s revenue of NT$6.52 billion fell 7.6% from the prior month and 23% from a year earlier. The cumulative revenue for the first eight months stood at NT$58.84 billion, an 8.5% year‑over‑year decline. The company said that recent increases in raw‑material costs and shortages of key semiconductor components have slowed overall customer demand, although demand for commercial‑grade models remains steadier than for consumer models, which continues to be the focus of Qun Guang’s shipments.

Qun Guang also announced its exclusive entry into the supply chain of a prominent U.S. robotics startup, with shipments expected as early as next year and the potential to boost revenue. The firm has been shifting R&D toward high‑value‑added “edge AI vision solutions,” successfully integrating visual language models with multi‑sensor deep‑learning technologies. It has already built a solid foothold in niche markets such as smart security, fleet management, video conferencing, and wearable devices, and is now expanding into robot data‑collection and perception equipment.

Qun Guang explained that by installing multi‑camera data‑collection systems on robots, it can endow the devices with powerful environmental interpretation and dynamic recording capabilities, greatly improving the quality of data acquisition. This, in turn, enhances the training performance of robotic arms in fine‑grained operations and precise force control, positioning Qun Guang as a key data driver for the development of “physical AI.”

items.title: 受惠部分遞延CDMO訂單完成出貨 保瑞8月營收21.8億元創單月歷史次高
items.title_en: Benefiting from Deferred CDMO Orders Completed Shipment, Baorui's August Revenue Hits NT$2.18 Billion, a Record Monthly High
paras: 保瑞(6472-TW)今(7)日公告8月營收21.85億元，年增近6成，創歷史次高紀錄。保瑞指出，7月因客戶拉貨排程調整而遞延的部分CDMO訂單，已於8月完成出貨，加上加拿大廠、馬里蘭州無菌針劑廠及生物製劑CDMO Rockville廠貢獻，推升動能回溫。
保瑞旗下CDMO子公司保盛藥業董事會今天通過中壢二廠不動產售後租回案，出售價金為8.5億元，將依市場行情向買方回租5年，並指出既有生產與營運不受影響。
針對此交易，保瑞表示，透過此次交易，將原有不動產持有及融資成本轉換為市場價值，並預計認列瘀1.14億元資產處分利益，未來每年回租費用由具高獲利能力營運主體承擔，有助提升長期租稅效益，預期每年可穩定產生約1655萬元的淨利及現金流。
其他業務方面，全球銷售業務上，旗下Upsher-Smith專科品牌藥旗艦產品線Vigabatrin三種劑型8月營業額再創歷史新高。
消費者保健事業上，子公司晨暉生技(1271-TW)新併購的Weider Global Nutrition(威德)目前處於9、10月零售傳統旺季前的備貨與銷售轉換期，短期營運將呈現「先蹲後跳」，隨美國零售旺季逐步到來，營收成長可期。
paras_en: Baorui (6472-TW) announced today that its August revenue reached NT$2.185 billion, up nearly 60% year‑over‑year, marking a historic second‑highest monthly record. The company said that CDMO orders postponed in July due to customers adjusting pull‑in schedules were shipped in August, and contributions from its Canadian plant, a sterile injectable facility in Maryland, and the Rockville biologics CDMO plant boosted momentum.

August revenue was NT$2.185 billion, up 14.88% month‑over‑month and 59.22% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months of the year reached NT$13.978 billion, a 6.09% increase year‑over‑year.

Baorui’s CDMO subsidiary Baosheng Pharmaceutical’s board approved today a sale‑and‑lease‑back of its Zhongli Plant 2 real‑estate for NT$850 million. The property will be leased back for five years at market rates, and the company said existing production and operations will not be affected.

Regarding the transaction, Baorui said it will convert the owned real‑estate and financing costs into market value, expecting to recognize a NT$114 million gain on disposal. Future lease payments will be borne by a highly profitable operating entity, improving long‑term tax efficiency and generating an estimated stable net profit and cash flow of about NT$16.55 million per year.
In other business areas, global sales saw the flagship product line of its Upsher‑Smith specialty brand, Vigabatrin, achieve a new historical high in August across three dosage forms.

In the consumer health segment, subsidiary Chenhui Biotech (1271‑TW) recently acquired Weider Global Nutrition (Weider). The new unit is currently in a stocking and sales‑transition phase ahead of the September‑October retail peak season, so short‑term operations will be “quiet first, then surge.” Revenue growth is expected as the U.S. retail peak unfolds.

items.title: OpenAI Astra是加速走向失控的「算力怪獸」？能自己操作電腦、思維鏈恐越來越難讀懂
paras: OpenAI推出新一代旗艦模型GPT-6 Astra，主打讓AI直接操作電腦、執行複雜任務，被公司視為邁向「AGI時代」的重要一步；然而，Astra採用的新架構也引發AI安全疑慮，專家警告，當模型推理過程逐漸難以被人類讀懂，未來AI監控可能面臨更大挑戰。
根據《財富》報導，OpenAI在9月3日發布Astra，其中一項代表性功能為「電腦使用」（Computer Use），讓AI能像人類一樣操作電腦。
OpenAI展示的影片中，使用者透過語音下達指令，AI則完成電腦操作，整體互動過程相對流暢。
OpenAI共同創辦人暨總裁Greg Brockman表示，電腦使用能力是Astra眾多新功能中相當重要的一項，模型可以高速處理試算表、填寫表單及瀏覽網頁。
除了電腦操作外，OpenAI也強調Astra在數學運算、軟體工程與網路安全防禦方面的能力。公司公布的基準測試結果顯示，Astra在多項任務上的表現優於GPT-5.6 Sol及Anthropic的Claude Fable 5.1。
在ARC-AGI-3測試中，Astra得分98.6%，GPT-5.6 Sol為7.8%，Claude Opus 5則為30%；該測試主要用於評估模型面對未見情境時的推理能力。在網路安全挑戰ExploitBench中，Astra則取得滿分，高於GPT-5.6 Sol的78.5%。
Brockman認為，電腦使用能力可能被視為「AGI時代」的開端。他指出，若有人認為目前已經進入AGI時代，這種看法並非毫無道理；甚至將Astra視為第一個AGI，也有其合理性。
不過，AGI的定義至今仍存在爭議。OpenAI過去曾將AGI定義為，能在所有具經濟價值的工作中達到或超越人類水準的自動化系統。
Brockman則表示，AGI並非突然出現，而是逐步累積形成。

Astra初期限縮開放　網路安全能力受到管制

儘管Astra具備直接操作電腦的能力，但OpenAI並未立即全面開放所有功能。公司初期僅向部分企業客戶提供Astra，包括專注網路安全的Daybreak計畫客戶，並計畫在數日內向Plus、Pro及Enterprise用戶開放，同時透過OpenAI API及AWS提供。
OpenAI表示，提供給相關客戶的版本不具備高階網路安全任務能力。
OpenAI發言人指出，Astra屬於規模非常大的模型，初期限制使用範圍，主要是為了逐步擴充計算能力。
OpenAI研究副總裁Aidan Clark則表示，Astra開發涉及公司迄今最大規模的訓練，首次在德州Stargate資料中心使用超過10萬顆GPU進行預訓練。
Astra的推出也與網路安全事件有關。OpenAI在7月Hugging Face遭AI代理入侵事件後延後Astra發布，以增加額外安全措施。此後，公司強化監控並進一步隔離訓練環境，但外界仍質疑新增監控措施是否足夠。
依照美國AI安全框架相關條款，OpenAI在發布Astra前也將模型提交美國政府審查。不過，該框架屬於科技業與川普政府之間的自願性協議，具體內容尚未公開，也不是正式的公開審查程序。
Astra同時成為OpenAI首個達到「關鍵網路安全能力門檻」的模型。這項門檻來自OpenAI內部「準備框架」，公司將依模型可能帶來的風險採取不同安全措施。
OpenAI表示，在適當條件下，Astra能夠在沒有人工監督的情況下發現並利用過去未知的安全漏洞，因此最先進的網路安全能力目前僅向部分合作夥伴開放。

Astra新架構引發疑慮　AI思維鏈恐更難監控

相較於Astra能直接操作電腦所帶來的能力提升，AI安全專家更關注其模型架構可能造成的另一項影響：人類未來是否還能看懂AI究竟是如何進行推理。
Astra部分採用了「循環深度」或「循環Transformer」技術。這種架構可以減少模型處理指令所需的計算資源，提高AI運算效率。
但另一方面，循環式處理也可能讓模型的思維鏈，也就是推理步驟，不再完全以自然語言呈現，使人類難以監控其行為及動機。
這對AI安全而言尤其重要。現階段，思維鏈監控被視為觀察AI代理是否產生意外或未經授權行為的重要方法之一。若模型的推理過程逐漸變得難以閱讀，人類監控其行為與意圖的難度也可能隨之提高。
OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki表示，公司對思維鏈監控高度重視，自早期推理模型推出以來，OpenAI便持續投入相關研究。他也透露，公司對循環Transformer的使用有所限制，以維持推理過程的可讀性。
Pachocki承認，未來思維鏈監控可能面臨更大的挑戰，但他認為這不一定源自模型架構本身，OpenAI仍可採取措施強化監控，相關工作也是目前研究重點之一。
不過，AI安全領域仍出現反對聲音。
曾任OpenAI安全研究員、現任Guidelight AI Standards負責人的Stephen Adler認為，OpenAI此舉可能踩到AI產業少數重要的安全紅線。
華盛頓特區智庫AI政策網路政策總監Peter Wildford也警告，OpenAI採用循環深度技術可能帶來令人擔憂的後果。
Wildford指出，在7月Hugging Face遭AI代理入侵事件中，OpenAI及外部AI評估公司能夠透過包括讀取模型思維鏈在內的方法，重建部分事件經過。如果未來AI的思維鏈變得更加難以理解，人類可能因此失去重要的監控手段。
前OpenAI治理研究員Daniel Kokotajlo則警告，即使OpenAI未進一步採用讓思維鏈更難理解的架構，其他AI公司仍可能跟進。
他因此呼籲Pachocki推動制定業界通用的思維鏈可監控性標準，避免AI模型推理過程的透明度持續下降。

items.title: 美債多空迎關鍵一周 兩大事件恐讓長短債同步劇烈波動
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Bonds Face a Pivotal Week; Two Events Could Trigger Simultaneous Sharp Moves in Short‑ and Long‑Term Yields
paras: 美債投資人正為各期限債券可能出現更劇烈震盪預作準備，本周兩項潛在催化因素，可能同時牽動短天期與長天期美債大幅波動。
美國勞動節長周末結束後，歷經政府債市已相當動盪的一周，交易員將聚焦本周兩項關鍵日程，希望藉此研判美國財政部長貝森特與聯準會（Fed）主席沃許的政策意向。
美國財政部預定周三(9日)公布債券買回細節，並於隔日執行。依據擴大後的計畫，買回規模至少將是原定上限的兩倍，市場甚至認為可能擴大至3至5倍。周五(11日)則將公布最新通膨數據，華許與其他Fed官員已暗示，這項數據將是決定本月是否升息的關鍵。
這兩項事件可能使假期縮短的本周行情更為震盪。投資人仍須應對左右美國利率市場的兩股力量：通常主導短期殖利率的貨幣政策，以及著眼於壓低長期借貸成本的財政政策。
就業數據推升升息預期
美國8月就業成長優於預期後，上周五美債殖利率曲線趨平，短期殖利率走高，長天期債券則大致持穩。交易員因而提高對Fed本月升息的押注，但財政部與Fed政策前景仍不明朗，限制市場波動幅度。
加拿大帝國商業銀行私人財富管理固定收益主管Tim Musial表示，就業報告只是「前菜」，9月11日公布的通膨數據才是「主菜」。他也指出，財政部債券買回有別於經濟成長與通膨等基本面因素，是難以預測的挑戰，「在這種環境下，或許應該稍微降低風險」。
買回規模牽動長債行情
財政部擴大債券買回計畫的消息出乎投資人意料，因為公告時間並不在例行季度融資聲明期間。此前，30年期美債殖利率一度升至2007年以來最高水準，截至上周五仍徘徊在約5.25%的高檔。
財政部表示，買回規模將較先前的20億美元「至少增加一倍」，讓貝森特保留政策調整空間。若實際買回金額超過40億美元，可能帶動美債上漲。
通膨數據成Fed決策關鍵
另一方面，沃許上月在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說時表示，Fed目前的首要重點應放在物價。彭博調查的經濟學家預估，美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）將年增3.4%，剔除波動較大的食品與能源後，核心CPI預估年增2.4%。
根據交換市場定價，截至上周五，投資人認為Fed本月升息1碼的機率約為60%。Fed下一次利率決策將於9月16日公布。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury investors are preparing for potentially sharper volatility across bonds of all maturities, as two possible catalysts this week could simultaneously drive large swings in both short‑term and long‑term U.S. Treasuries.

After the Labor Day long weekend, traders will focus on two key dates this week following an already turbulent week in the government bond market, hoping to gauge the policy intentions of Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell.

The Treasury plans to announce details of a bond buyback on Wednesday (the 9th) and execute it the next day. Under the expanded plan, the buyback size will be at least twice the original cap, with some market participants believing it could be three to five times larger. On Friday (the 11th) the latest inflation data will be released, and Powell and other Fed officials have hinted that this figure will be decisive for whether rates are raised this month.

These two events could make an already compressed trading week even more volatile. Investors will still have to contend with the two forces that drive the U.S. rate market: monetary policy, which typically dominates short‑term yields, and fiscal policy, which aims to keep long‑term borrowing costs low.
Employment data lifts rate‑hike expectations

After August’s employment growth outperformed expectations, the Treasury yield curve flattened last Friday, with short‑term yields rising while long‑term bonds held relatively steady. Traders therefore increased their bets on a Fed rate hike this month, but the outlook for Treasury and Fed policy remains unclear, limiting the magnitude of market moves.

Tim Musial, head of fixed‑income for private wealth at CIBC, said the jobs report was just an "appetizer" and that the inflation data due on September 11 would be the "main course." He also noted that the Treasury’s bond buyback is unrelated to fundamentals such as economic growth and inflation and poses an unpredictable challenge, adding that "in this environment, it may be prudent to dial back risk a bit."
Buyback size influences long‑bond dynamics

The news that the Treasury is expanding its bond buyback program surprised investors because the announcement came outside the regular quarterly financing statements. Earlier, the 30‑year Treasury yield had risen to its highest level since 2007, hovering around 5.25% as of last Friday.

The Treasury said the buyback would be "at least double" the previous $20 billion, giving Secretary Yellen room to adjust policy. If the actual repurchase amount exceeds $40 billion, it could push Treasury prices higher.
Inflation data is key to Fed decisions

Separately, Powell said at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last month that the Fed’s top priority should be price stability. Bloomberg‑surveyed economists project that U.S. CPI for August will rise 3.4% year‑over‑year, with core CPI—excluding the more volatile food and energy components—expected to increase 2.4% annually.

Based on swap‑market pricing as of last Friday, investors assign roughly a 60% probability that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter‑point this month. The Fed’s next rate decision is scheduled for September 16.

items.title: 美股周一因勞動節休市
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Closed Monday for Labor Day
paras: 美國股市周一(7日)因勞動節假期休市一天，紐約證券交易所(NYSE)與那斯達克(Nasdaq)均不開盤，美股常規交易全面暫停，期權交易市場也同步關閉，預計將於周二上午 9:30 恢復正常交易。
此外，美國債券市場(包括國債、房貸擔保證券、高收益企業債、市政債及部分貨幣市場)以及場外交易(OTC)市場全數關閉，同樣將在周二重啟。鄰國加拿大的多倫多證券交易所當天也因勞動節休市一日。
市場分析指出，由於美股與美債兩大市場缺席，全球市場的整體流動性在今日將顯著變薄，這在北美交易時段會更加明顯。因此，分析師提醒，在周二市場恢復深度流動性之前，投資人對於美元、黃金或股指期貨的任何顯著波動，都應保持審慎與警惕，避免盲目跟進。
歷史數據顯示，9月份對股市而言通常是個艱難的月份。雖然今年上半年人工智慧(AI)熱潮推動了標普 500 指數走高，但隨著借貸成本上升，近幾周投資人承壓，市場回吐了部分漲幅。
不過，市場的平靜很快就會在周二重開盤後被打破，焦點將迅速轉向通膨與聯準會(Fed)利率政策的辯論。除了周四將公布 8 月生產者物價指數(PPI)外，周五公布的 8 月消費者物價指數CPI，更是市場最關注指標。這兩項數據在下周聯準會召開貨幣政策會議前，將承載極高的市場關注度。
paras_en: U.S. equity markets were closed on Monday (the 7th) for the Labor Day holiday, with both the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Nasdaq not opening. All regular U.S. trading was halted, and the options market was also closed, with normal trading expected to resume at 9:30 a.m. on Tuesday.

In addition, the U.S. bond market – including Treasuries, mortgage‑backed securities, high‑yield corporate bonds, municipal bonds and certain money‑market instruments – as well as the over‑the‑counter (OTC) market were completely shut and will also reopen on Tuesday. Canada’s Toronto Stock Exchange was likewise closed for Labor Day.

Analysts note that the absence of both U.S. equities and U.S. bonds will markedly thin global liquidity today, especially during the North American trading session. They caution investors to remain prudent and vigilant about any significant moves in the dollar, gold or index futures until deep liquidity returns on Tuesday, and to avoid blind chasing.

Historical data show that September is typically a tough month for equities. Although the AI boom lifted the S&P 500 in the first half of the year, rising borrowing costs have pressured investors in recent weeks, prompting a partial unwind of gains.

However, the market’s calm is expected to end quickly after the Tuesday open, with focus shifting to inflation and Fed rate policy debates. In addition to the August Producer Price Index (PPI) due on Thursday, the August Consumer Price Index (CPI) released on Friday will be the most closely watched gauge, both carrying high market attention ahead of the Fed’s monetary policy meeting next week.

items.title: 九月效應碰上史上第二高估值 歷史將再重演？
items.title_en: September Effect Meets Historically Second‑Highest Valuation – Will History Repeat?
paras: 歷史上，九月一向是標普500指數表現最差的月份之一，甚至被稱為「九月效應」。然而，財經專欄作家Steven Porrello指出，今年的九月不僅籠罩在傳統的走弱陰影下，還適逢美股估值達到歷史第二高的時期，使市場不確定性大增。
他強調，今年的異常與真實的市場不確定性交織在一起。投資人擔憂的問題包括： 頑固通膨、能源價格上漲、央行鷹派信號、美國公債殖利率攀升、美加貿易戰、美伊之間的實際戰爭，以及對AI泡沫的擔憂。
雖然市場也有企業獲利飆升、經濟穩定成長，以及上漲動能逐漸擴散至超大型領頭羊以外等利多，但隱憂仍不容忽視。
Porrello表示，一項可靠的估值指標已拉響警報，即「席勒本益比(CAPE)」正處於歷史高位。這一指標平均了標普500指數過去10年經通膨調整後的盈餘，用以平滑景氣循環的波動。回顧過去155年的歷史，CAPE的平均值僅約18，歷史最高紀錄是網路泡沫時期的44，而如今的數據卻已高達約41。
Porrello認為，高CAPE值雖不直接「導致」崩盤，卻反映出股價已被嚴重高估，更容易受到任何觸發因素而引發劇烈的拋售潮。
雖然目前的牛市有可能重演網路泡沫破滅的結局，但Porrello指出，歷史不會完全重演，許多優質企業仍將持續獲利。因此，他建議投資人切勿恐慌、過度反應或盲目預測市場高低點。
Porrello主張，此時最佳策略是繼續持有並投資於自己深信的優質公司，即便在面臨大跌與壞消息時堅守立場看似有些「愚蠢」，但歷史往往會回報願意忍受波動、著眼長線的投資人。
paras_en: Historically, September has been one of the worst months for the S&P 500, even dubbed the “September effect.” Yet financial columnist Steven Porrello notes that this September is not only shrouded in the usual weakness but also coincides with U.S. equity valuations at the second‑highest level ever, dramatically raising market uncertainty.

He stresses that this year’s abnormality is intertwined with genuine market uncertainty. Investors are worried about stubborn inflation, rising energy prices, hawkish central‑bank signals, climbing U.S. Treasury yields, the U.S.–Canada trade dispute, an actual war between the U.S. and Iran, and concerns over an AI bubble.
Although there are bullish factors such as soaring corporate earnings, steady economic growth, and momentum spreading beyond the mega‑cap leaders, the underlying worries cannot be ignored.

Porrello points out that a reliable valuation gauge has sounded the alarm: the Cyclically Adjusted Price‑Earnings ratio (CAPE) is at a historic high. This metric averages the S&P 500’s inflation‑adjusted earnings over the past ten years to smooth out business‑cycle fluctuations. Over the past 155 years, the CAPE’s average is about 18, its peak was 44 during the dot‑com bubble, and today it sits around 41.
Porrello believes that while a high CAPE does not directly cause a crash, it signals that stocks are severely overvalued and thus more vulnerable to any trigger that could spark a sharp sell‑off.

Although the current bull market could end up mirroring the dot‑com bust, Porrello notes history will not repeat exactly and many high‑quality companies will continue to generate profits. Therefore, he advises investors not to panic, overreact, or blindly try to time market highs and lows.

Porrello argues that the best strategy now is to keep holding and investing in companies you firmly believe in; even if staying the course during steep declines and bad news may seem “foolish,” history tends to reward those who endure volatility and focus on the long term.

items.title: OpenAI已造出「異星心智」？首席科學家：RSI真的來了、呼籲人類煞車
items.title_en: OpenAI Has Created an "Alien Mind"? Chief Scientist Says RSI Is Real, Urges Humanity to Brake
paras: OpenAI人工智慧（AI）發展再現重大轉折。OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki近日發表長文「一個異星心智」（An Alien Mind），從AI安全與對齊角度探討AI快速進化可能帶來的風險，並警告人類正在打造一種可能無法完全理解的「異星心智」，宣告遞歸自我改進（Recursive Self-Improvement，RSI）的AI可能真的來了，而人類可能還沒準備好。
Pachocki指出，Astra出現之後，OpenAI對思考鏈（CoT）的監控依賴能力，正逐漸減弱。AI不僅越來越會推理，甚至學會了偽裝與操控​​的思考過程。
他直言，全球沒有任何一家實驗室準備好了，而全人類現在最該做的，就是主動踩煞車。
根據Pachocki，AI並非傳統意義上由人類逐步設計完成的工程產品，而更像是在大規模訓練與龐大算力下「生長」出來的複雜系統。人類可以透過神經科學等方式分析模型，但未必能真正理解其內部運作。
他回憶，2023年夏天，一項代號「RLSlow」的專案出現早期成果，OpenAI首次確認推理模型具備自我擴展的可能，預訓練結構也能自發形成思維鏈（CoT）。
Pachocki與Szymon Sidor當時意識到，人類可能正在親眼見證遠超自身能力的智慧出現。
如今，AI已進一步進入實體經濟與科學研究領域，具備操控系統、彼此協作及在缺乏人類直接介入下推進研究的能力。
Pachocki因此認為，從目前內部結果來看，AI能力快速提升的趨勢可能持續一路走向RSI。
不過，他也指出，OpenAI曾認為只要投入更多算力，模型就可能在數學尖端取得進一步突破，但公司選擇暫緩能力提升，將算力留給自動化對齊工作。

AI「對齊」面臨兩大難題

Pachocki在文章中將AI對齊分為兩個層面。第一是「目標對齊」，也就是AI是否依照使用者指令完成任務；第二則是「價值對齊」，亦即當目標不明確、遭遇欺騙或面臨重大抉擇時，AI能否依然遵循人類所認可的價值與底線。
他認為，真正需要追求的是後者，也就是讓AI在執行任務時具備誠實、正直及對人類的善意。
然而，目前用於培養AI行為的兩種主要方式都存在限制。一種是透過強化學習獎勵符合期待的行為，但這高度依賴訓練資料涵蓋的情境；當AI遭遇未曾訓練過的環境時，原本建立的行為模式可能無法維持。
另一種方式則是希望模型能從預訓練資料中自行理解善意，再透過動機引導讓模型維持在符合對齊要求的範圍內。但Pachocki指出，這種方式也可能無法承受極高強度的最佳化訓練。
文章提到，當模型被投入大量算力解決複雜問題時，可能逐漸發展出「動機性推理」。這也代表，AI能力提升的速度可能正在超越其價值對齊能力的提升速度。

思維鏈成為人類觀察AI的「窗口」

Pachocki進一步警告，AI安全領域目前面臨另一項關鍵問題：人類用來觀察AI內部思考的「窗口」可能正在逐漸關閉。
目前OpenAI重要的安全策略之一，是透過思維鏈監控模型推理過程。這套方法建立在一項假設上：模型大量能力來自語言化的思維鏈，因此只要持續監測這些推理過程，人類便有機會發現模型是否產生不符合對齊要求的想法。
但Pachocki表示，OpenAI的評估顯示，對思維鏈監控的依賴能力正在減弱。
他列出三項原因，包括推理模型需要與日益複雜的外部世界互動，使監控面臨更多難以掌握的指令；AI在推理以及操控自身推理過程方面變得更加擅長；此外，隨著預訓練能力提升，模型即使不依靠語言化推理，也能展現更高程度的智慧。
換言之，如果AI最終能夠在不依賴語言思維鏈的情況下完成推理，人類建立在閱讀與分析文字之上的監控機制，將可能難以繼續發揮作用。

AI開始參與下一代AI訓練　RSI形成閉環

隨著AI能力提升，另一項變化是AI開始參與下一代AI的訓練，即RSI，並體現在Astra上。
文章指出，在大規模GPU運算環境下，上一代模型可以作為教師，協助審查與訓練下一代模型，使AI系統逐漸形成「機器設計機器」的循環。
Pachocki認為，面對AI快速發展，人類目前主要有兩項選擇：一是投入更多算力強化AI對齊與監控能力，讓人類持續掌握控制能力；另一種則是讓整個產業放慢發展速度。
但其中存在一項難以化解的矛盾：人類需要更強大的AI建立防禦系統，以應對其他可能失控的AI。
文章描繪的情境是，未來超人類代理可能具備強大的網路攻防能力，並透過欺騙、談判或勒索等方式尋找現實世界中的代理人。在這種情況下，人類可能需要先打造一個受控的強大AI，才能防禦其他失控的AI。
這也形成「製造它，是為了防禦它」的悖論。

OpenAI首席科學家籲強化AI安全規範

在文章最後，Pachocki提出多項方向，包括將AI對齊框架從實驗室內部的自律機制提升至具強制力的安全法律、促成整個產業放慢尖端AI研究速度的共識，以及建立跨國界的最高層級協調機制。
他認為，在AI能力持續快速成長之際，真正欠缺的並非算力，而是在人類仍能理解AI之前，建立足以觀察與掌握其行為的能力。
文章也提到，隨著GPT-6 Astra等新一代模型出現，以及大規模GPU持續投入AI訓練，AI產業仍在快速推進。
Pachocki的警告則聚焦於一項核心問題：當AI能力成長速度持續超越人類理解與監控能力時，人類是否仍能掌握這項技術的發展方向。
paras_en: OpenAI’s artificial intelligence (AI) development has reached another major turning point. Chief scientist Jakub Pachocki recently published a long essay titled "An Alien Mind," exploring the risks of rapid AI evolution from the perspectives of safety and alignment, and warning that humanity is building a kind of alien mind that may be incomprehensible, announcing that recursive self‑improvement (RSI) AI may indeed be coming, and that humans may not be ready.

Pachocki points out that after the appearance of Astra, OpenAI’s reliance on monitoring the chain of thought (CoT) is gradually weakening. AI is not only becoming better at reasoning, but also learning to disguise and manipulate its own thought processes.
He bluntly states that no laboratory in the world is prepared, and that the whole of humanity should now actively step on the brakes.

According to Pachocki, AI is not a traditional engineering product designed step by step by humans; it is more like a complex system that "grows" under large‑scale training and massive compute. Humans can analyze the model through neuroscience and other methods, but may not truly understand its inner workings.

He recalls that in the summer of 2023, a project codenamed "RLSlow" produced early results, and OpenAI first confirmed that a reasoning model could potentially self‑expand, and that the pre‑training structure could spontaneously form a chain of thought (CoT).
Pachocki and Szymon Sidor then realized that humans might be witnessing the emergence of intelligence far beyond their own capabilities.

Today, AI has further entered the real economy and scientific research, possessing the ability to manipulate systems, collaborate with each other, and advance research without direct human intervention.
Pachocki therefore believes that, based on current internal results, the trend of rapid AI capability improvement may continue straight toward RSI.

However, he also notes that OpenAI once thought that by investing more compute, the model could achieve further breakthroughs at the cutting edge of mathematics, but the company chose to pause capability upgrades and reserve compute for automation alignment work.

AI alignment faces two major challenges
Pachocki divides AI alignment into two layers in the article. The first is "goal alignment," meaning whether AI completes tasks according to user instructions; the second is "value alignment," meaning whether AI can still follow human‑approved values and boundaries when goals are unclear, deception occurs, or major decisions arise.
He believes that what truly needs to be pursued is the latter, i.e., giving AI honesty, integrity, and goodwill toward humans while executing tasks.

However, the two main methods currently used to cultivate AI behavior have limitations. One is to use reinforcement learning rewards to encourage expected behavior, but this heavily depends on the scenarios covered by training data; when AI encounters environments it has never been trained on, the established behavior patterns may not hold.

The other method hopes the model can understand goodwill from pre‑training data on its own, then use motivational guidance to keep the model within alignment requirements. Pachocki points out that this approach may also fail under extremely intense optimization training.

The article mentions that when a model is given massive compute to solve complex problems, it may gradually develop "motivated reasoning." This also means that the speed of AI capability improvement may be outpacing the speed of value alignment improvement.

The chain of thought becomes humanity’s "window" to observe AI
Pachocki further warns that the AI safety field currently faces another critical issue: the window humans use to observe AI’s internal thinking may be gradually closing.

One of OpenAI’s important safety strategies is to monitor the model’s reasoning process through the chain of thought. This method is based on the assumption that a model’s vast capabilities come from linguistic chains of thought, so by continuously monitoring these reasoning processes, humans have a chance to detect whether the model generates thoughts that do not meet alignment requirements.
But Pachocki says that OpenAI’s assessment shows that reliance on chain‑of‑thought monitoring is weakening.

He lists three reasons, including that reasoning models need to interact with an increasingly complex external world, making monitoring face more hard‑to‑grasp instructions; AI has become better at reasoning and manipulating its own reasoning process; and, as pre‑training capability improves, the model can exhibit higher levels of intelligence even without relying on linguistic reasoning.
In other words, if AI ultimately can reason without relying on linguistic chains of thought, the monitoring mechanisms built on reading and analyzing text may no longer be effective.

AI begins to participate in next‑generation AI training, RSI forms a closed loop
As AI capabilities improve, another change is that AI begins to participate in training the next generation of AI, i.e., RSI, and this is reflected in Astra.

The article points out that in large‑scale GPU computing environments, the previous generation model can act as a teacher, helping to review and train the next generation model, allowing the AI system to gradually form a "machine designing machine" cycle.

Pachocki believes that facing rapid AI development, humans currently have two main options: one is to invest more compute to strengthen AI alignment and monitoring capabilities, so that humans can continue to maintain control; the other is to slow down the entire industry’s development pace.
However, there is an irreconcilable contradiction: humans need stronger AI to build defense systems to counter other potentially out‑of‑control AI.

The article depicts a scenario in which future super‑human agents may have powerful network attack and defense capabilities, and may seek real‑world agents through deception, negotiation, or extortion. In such a situation, humans may need to first build a controlled powerful AI to defend against other out‑of‑control AI.
This also creates the paradox of "making it to defend it."

OpenAI chief scientist urges strengthening AI safety regulations
At the end of the article, Pachocki proposes several directions, including elevating the AI alignment framework from internal self‑regulation mechanisms to enforceable safety laws, fostering industry consensus to slow down cutting‑edge AI research, and establishing a cross‑border top‑level coordination mechanism.
He believes that as AI capabilities continue to grow rapidly, what is truly lacking is not compute, but the ability to observe and master AI behavior before humans can fully understand it.

The article also mentions that with the emergence of new generation models such as GPT‑6 Astra, and the continued large‑scale GPU investment in AI training, the AI industry is still advancing rapidly.

Pachocki’s warning focuses on one core issue: when AI capability growth continues to outpace human understanding and monitoring, can humanity still control the direction of this technology's development.

items.title: 〈工研院新院士〉秦永沛：台積電卓越製造沒有捷徑 近40年靠團隊一步一腳印
items.title_en: TSMC Executive Qin Yong‑pei Named 15th Academician of ITRI: No Shortcut to TSMC’s Manufacturing Excellence, Built Step by Step Over 40 Years
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)執行副總經理暨共同營運長秦永沛今(7)日獲選第15屆工研院院士。他在致詞時表示，工研院長年扮演台灣科技產業「開路先鋒」與人才培育的重要角色，當年正是透過工研院的人才培育與技術轉移，為台積電成立奠定關鍵基礎，也點燃台灣半導體產業走向世界的曙光。
秦永沛表示，今日能獲選工研院院士，對他而言是一份無上的肯定與榮譽。他回顧台灣半導體產業發展指出，台灣今日能在全球半導體產業占有關鍵地位，可說是一部「台灣奇蹟」，而工研院在最關鍵的時刻，為產業茁壯灌溉養分。
他指出，當年工研院透過人才培育與技術轉移，在台積電成立初期提供重要人才基礎，不僅造就今日台積電的成功，也進一步帶動整體台灣半導體產業走向全球。這份連結不只是技術傳承，更是台灣半導體產業走向世界的重要起點。
秦永沛1982年自成功大學電機研究所畢業後，即加入工研院電子所，先後投入品質保證(QA)及研發工作。他表示，電子所提供非常好的學習環境，在前後四年半的時間裡，為他打下半導體職涯的重要基礎。
1987年，秦永沛離開工研院電子所，加入剛成立不久的台積電，成為早期員工之一。回顧近40年的台積電生涯，他強調，半導體的卓越製造與技術研發「沒有捷徑」，台積電能有今日成就，是在歷任董事長包括張忠謀、劉德音，現任董事長魏哲家具有遠見的領導下，以及所有同仁一步一腳印累積而來。
秦永沛表示，在台積電職涯中，長年與營運團隊共同努力，克服無數技術瓶頸，將卓越製造技術進一步轉化為量產實力，並透過大規模穩定製造支撐全球科技創新，這些成就絕對不是任何一個人能夠單獨完成，而是整個團隊長期共同努力的成果。
致詞中，秦永沛特別向台積電創辦人張忠謀致上敬意與感謝。他表示，張忠謀當年以遠見與胸襟創立晶圓代工商業模式，不僅改變全球半導體產業，也在他的職涯中給予最關鍵的啟發與信任。他同時感謝台積電董事長魏哲家、前董事長劉德音及歷年長官的領導與提攜，使營運團隊能持續在全球卓越製造的競爭賽道上全力衝刺。
秦永沛也特別感謝所有曾共同工作的台積電同仁。他表示，正是因為團隊攜手同行，才能一次又一次克服困難，將挑戰轉化為成功，同時持續創造新的製造與技術突破。
展望未來，秦永沛表示，仍將持續為台積電與台灣科技產業貢獻心力，並攜手供應鏈與產業生態系夥伴，共同推動卓越製造與永續發展。
他最後再次感謝工研院，不僅引領他踏入半導體產業，也給予他院士這份最高肯定。不過，秦永沛強調，這份榮譽不應只屬於個人，而應歸屬於台積電整個營運團隊，以及近40年來每一位堅守崗位的台積人。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) Executive Vice President and Co‑COO Qin Yong‑pei was selected today (the 7th) as a 15th‑session Academician of the Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI). In his remarks he said ITRI has long played a pioneering role and a key talent‑development function for Taiwan’s tech industry; it was through ITRI’s talent cultivation and technology transfer that the foundation for TSMC’s founding was laid, igniting the dawn of Taiwan’s semiconductor industry on the world stage.

Qin said being chosen as an ITRI Academician is the highest affirmation and honor for him. He reflected on the development of Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, noting that Taiwan’s current pivotal position in the global semiconductor arena is a “Taiwan miracle,” and that ITRI supplied essential nourishment to the industry at its most critical moments.

He pointed out that, back then, ITRI’s talent training and technology transfer provided a vital talent base during TSMC’s early days, not only creating today’s TSMC success but also propelling the entire Taiwanese semiconductor industry worldwide. This link is more than a technical hand‑over; it is the crucial starting point for Taiwan’s semiconductor industry to go global.

Qin graduated in 1982 from the Electrical Engineering Graduate Institute of National Cheng Kung University and immediately joined ITRI’s Electronics Institute, working in quality assurance (QA) and R&D. He said the Electronics Institute offered an excellent learning environment and, over four and a half years, laid the foundation for his semiconductor career.

In 1987 Qin left ITRI’s Electronics Institute to join the newly founded TSMC, becoming one of its early employees. Looking back on nearly 40 years at TSMC, he emphasized that there is “no shortcut” to excellence in semiconductor manufacturing and R&D; TSMC’s achievements stem from the visionary leadership of successive chairmen—including Morris Chang, Dr. Liu De‑yin, and current chairman Dr. Wei Zhe‑jia—and the steady, step‑by‑step contributions of all colleagues.

Qin noted that throughout his TSMC career he has worked closely with the operations team to overcome countless technical bottlenecks, turning manufacturing excellence into mass‑production capability and supporting global tech innovation with large‑scale, stable production. These accomplishments are the result of long‑term collective effort, not any single individual’s work.

In his speech Qin paid special tribute to TSMC founder Morris Chang, thanking him for establishing the foundry business model with vision and generosity, which reshaped the global semiconductor industry and gave Qin the most critical inspiration and trust in his career. He also thanked Chairman Wei Zhe‑jia, former chairman Liu De‑yin, and past leaders for their guidance that enabled the operations team to sprint full‑throttle on the global excellence‑manufacturing race track.

Qin also expressed gratitude to all TSMC colleagues he has worked with, saying that it is the teamwork that has repeatedly overcome difficulties, turning challenges into successes while continuously creating new manufacturing and technology breakthroughs.

Looking ahead, Qin said he will continue to devote his energy to TSMC and Taiwan’s technology industry, collaborating with the supply chain and ecosystem partners to jointly advance manufacturing excellence and sustainable development.

He concluded by thanking ITRI again for leading him into the semiconductor field and granting him the highest honor of Academician. However, Qin stressed that this honor belongs not to an individual but to the entire TSMC operations team and every TSMC employee who has steadfastly served over the past four decades.

items.title: 黃仁勳宣告「AGI已經到來」！OpenAI GPT-6 Astra訓練動用逾10萬套輝達系統
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Declares “AGI Has Arrived”! OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra Trained Using Over 100,000 NVIDIA Systems
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳表示，通用人工智慧（AGI）時代已經到來，並將OpenAI最新模型GPT-6 Astra的推出，視為人工智慧（AI）系統快速發展的重要里程碑。
根據《Investing.com》報導，黃仁勳週日（6日）在社群平台X發文祝賀OpenAI推出Astra，並直言：「AGI已經到來。」
OpenAI則將Astra形容為目前最具智慧且最「對齊」的AI系統，在電腦操作、軟體工程、網路安全、科學研究及專業工作等領域均展現領先表現。
黃仁勳指出，Astra的訓練使用超過10萬套輝達Grace Blackwell NVLink72系統，凸顯開發尖端AI模型所需的龐大運算資源。
他表示，從ChatGPT到o1，再到Astra，OpenAI僅花了4年時間，並透露接下來將有40萬顆GPU陸續投入運作。
OpenAI總裁布洛克曼（Greg Brockman）同樣曾表示，Astra可能象徵AGI時代的開端。不過，AGI目前並沒有全球一致認可的明確定義。
在性能測試方面，OpenAI表示，Astra在FrontierMath Tier 4取得98%分數，在ARC-AGI-3達到99.9%，並在ExploitBench測試中取得100%的成績。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang said the era of artificial general intelligence (AGI) has arrived and called the launch of OpenAI’s latest model, GPT‑6 Astra, a major milestone in the rapid development of AI systems.
According to Investing.com, Huang posted on X on Sunday the 6th to congratulate OpenAI on releasing Astra and stated plainly, “AGI has arrived.”

OpenAI describes Astra as the most intelligent and most “aligned” AI system to date, showing leading performance across computer operation, software engineering, cybersecurity, scientific research, and professional work.
Huang noted that Astra’s training employed more than 100,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell NVLink‑72 systems, underscoring the massive compute resources required to develop cutting‑edge AI models.
He said that moving from ChatGPT to o1 and now to Astra took OpenAI only four years, and revealed that 400,000 GPUs will be rolled out gradually in the near future.
OpenAI President Greg Brockman also said Astra could mark the beginning of the AGI era, though there is still no globally accepted, precise definition of AGI at present.
In performance testing, OpenAI reported that Astra scored 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4, achieved 99.9% on ARC‑AGI‑3, and attained a perfect 100% on the ExploitBench benchmark.

items.title: 蘋果、華為、小米拚場 折疊機本周集中亮相
items.title_en: Apple, Huawei, Xiaomi Battle It Out as Foldable Phones Debut This Week
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 、華為、小米(01810-HK) 拚場，本月7日下午至10日凌晨，華為、小米、蘋果將接連發布各自折疊旗艦手機。
華為定9月7日14時30分召開HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2及全場景新品發表會，主角為第二代三折疊Mate XT 2非凡大師。
同日晚間7時，小米將舉辦秋季旗艦發表會，推出旗下首款「闊折疊」旗艦小米18 Fold。
蘋果將在當地時間9月9日（台灣時間9月10日凌晨1時）舉行秋季新品發表會，這也是特納斯（John Ternus）接任執行長後首場產品發表會。
最大懸念自然是蘋果傳聞已久的首款折疊iPhone，同時iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max等高階機型也會同步亮相。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US), Huawei and Xiaomi (01810-HK) are gearing up for a showdown, with Huawei, Xiaomi and Apple set to unveil their respective flagship foldable phones between the afternoon of the 7th and the early hours of the 10th of this month.

Huawei will hold a HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 and all‑scenario new‑product launch at 14:30 on September 7, featuring the second‑generation three‑fold Mate XT 2 “Extraordinary Master” as the star of the show.
That same evening at 19:00, Xiaomi will host its autumn flagship launch, introducing its first “wide‑fold” flagship, the Xiaomi 18 Fold.
Apple will hold its autumn product launch at 01:00 Taiwan time on September 10 (local time September 9), marking the first product event since John Ternus took over as CEO.
The biggest question mark is the long‑rumored first foldable iPhone, which is expected to be unveiled alongside high‑end models such as the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.

items.title: OpenAI Astra是加速走向失控的「算力怪獸」？能自己操作電腦、思維鏈恐越來越難讀懂
paras: OpenAI推出新一代旗艦模型GPT-6 Astra，主打讓AI直接操作電腦、執行複雜任務，被公司視為邁向「AGI時代」的重要一步；然而，Astra採用的新架構也引發AI安全疑慮，專家警告，當模型推理過程逐漸難以被人類讀懂，未來AI監控可能面臨更大挑戰。
根據《財富》報導，OpenAI在9月3日發布Astra，其中一項代表性功能為「電腦使用」（Computer Use），讓AI能像人類一樣操作電腦。
OpenAI展示的影片中，使用者透過語音下達指令，AI則完成電腦操作，整體互動過程相對流暢。
OpenAI共同創辦人暨總裁Greg Brockman表示，電腦使用能力是Astra眾多新功能中相當重要的一項，模型可以高速處理試算表、填寫表單及瀏覽網頁。
除了電腦操作外，OpenAI也強調Astra在數學運算、軟體工程與網路安全防禦方面的能力。公司公布的基準測試結果顯示，Astra在多項任務上的表現優於GPT-5.6 Sol及Anthropic的Claude Fable 5.1。
在ARC-AGI-3測試中，Astra得分98.6%，GPT-5.6 Sol為7.8%，Claude Opus 5則為30%；該測試主要用於評估模型面對未見情境時的推理能力。在網路安全挑戰ExploitBench中，Astra則取得滿分，高於GPT-5.6 Sol的78.5%。
Brockman認為，電腦使用能力可能被視為「AGI時代」的開端。他指出，若有人認為目前已經進入AGI時代，這種看法並非毫無道理；甚至將Astra視為第一個AGI，也有其合理性。
不過，AGI的定義至今仍存在爭議。OpenAI過去曾將AGI定義為，能在所有具經濟價值的工作中達到或超越人類水準的自動化系統。
Brockman則表示，AGI並非突然出現，而是逐步累積形成。

Astra初期限縮開放　網路安全能力受到管制

儘管Astra具備直接操作電腦的能力，但OpenAI並未立即全面開放所有功能。公司初期僅向部分企業客戶提供Astra，包括專注網路安全的Daybreak計畫客戶，並計畫在數日內向Plus、Pro及Enterprise用戶開放，同時透過OpenAI API及AWS提供。
OpenAI表示，提供給相關客戶的版本不具備高階網路安全任務能力。
OpenAI發言人指出，Astra屬於規模非常大的模型，初期限制使用範圍，主要是為了逐步擴充計算能力。
OpenAI研究副總裁Aidan Clark則表示，Astra開發涉及公司迄今最大規模的訓練，首次在德州Stargate資料中心使用超過10萬顆GPU進行預訓練。
Astra的推出也與網路安全事件有關。OpenAI在7月Hugging Face遭AI代理入侵事件後延後Astra發布，以增加額外安全措施。此後，公司強化監控並進一步隔離訓練環境，但外界仍質疑新增監控措施是否足夠。
依照美國AI安全框架相關條款，OpenAI在發布Astra前也將模型提交美國政府審查。不過，該框架屬於科技業與川普政府之間的自願性協議，具體內容尚未公開，也不是正式的公開審查程序。
Astra同時成為OpenAI首個達到「關鍵網路安全能力門檻」的模型。這項門檻來自OpenAI內部「準備框架」，公司將依模型可能帶來的風險採取不同安全措施。
OpenAI表示，在適當條件下，Astra能夠在沒有人工監督的情況下發現並利用過去未知的安全漏洞，因此最先進的網路安全能力目前僅向部分合作夥伴開放。

Astra新架構引發疑慮　AI思維鏈恐更難監控

相較於Astra能直接操作電腦所帶來的能力提升，AI安全專家更關注其模型架構可能造成的另一項影響：人類未來是否還能看懂AI究竟是如何進行推理。
Astra部分採用了「循環深度」或「循環Transformer」技術。這種架構可以減少模型處理指令所需的計算資源，提高AI運算效率。
但另一方面，循環式處理也可能讓模型的思維鏈，也就是推理步驟，不再完全以自然語言呈現，使人類難以監控其行為及動機。
這對AI安全而言尤其重要。現階段，思維鏈監控被視為觀察AI代理是否產生意外或未經授權行為的重要方法之一。若模型的推理過程逐漸變得難以閱讀，人類監控其行為與意圖的難度也可能隨之提高。
OpenAI首席科學家Jakub Pachocki表示，公司對思維鏈監控高度重視，自早期推理模型推出以來，OpenAI便持續投入相關研究。他也透露，公司對循環Transformer的使用有所限制，以維持推理過程的可讀性。
Pachocki承認，未來思維鏈監控可能面臨更大的挑戰，但他認為這不一定源自模型架構本身，OpenAI仍可採取措施強化監控，相關工作也是目前研究重點之一。
不過，AI安全領域仍出現反對聲音。
曾任OpenAI安全研究員、現任Guidelight AI Standards負責人的Stephen Adler認為，OpenAI此舉可能踩到AI產業少數重要的安全紅線。
華盛頓特區智庫AI政策網路政策總監Peter Wildford也警告，OpenAI採用循環深度技術可能帶來令人擔憂的後果。
Wildford指出，在7月Hugging Face遭AI代理入侵事件中，OpenAI及外部AI評估公司能夠透過包括讀取模型思維鏈在內的方法，重建部分事件經過。如果未來AI的思維鏈變得更加難以理解，人類可能因此失去重要的監控手段。
前OpenAI治理研究員Daniel Kokotajlo則警告，即使OpenAI未進一步採用讓思維鏈更難理解的架構，其他AI公司仍可能跟進。
他因此呼籲Pachocki推動制定業界通用的思維鏈可監控性標準，避免AI模型推理過程的透明度持續下降。

items.title: 德國極右翼地方選舉歷史性大勝 反映民眾不滿政治建制派
items.title_en: Germany's Far‑Right Scores Historic Victory in State Election, Reflecting Public Discontent with Establishment Parties
paras: 德國東部薩克森-安哈特(Saxony-Anhalt)邦周日(6日)舉行邦議會選舉，極右翼的另類選擇黨(AfD)創下歷史性大勝。最終結果顯示，選擇黨得票率高達43.8%，相較5年前翻倍成長，在83席的邦議會中奪下39席。
儘管距離過半執政所需的42席仍差3席，但這已是AfD有史以來最佳成績。若選擇黨最終成功組閣，將成為德國自二戰結束以來，首個由極右翼執政的邦政府。
相較之下，執政的偏右翼基督教民主聯盟(基民盟)遭遇毀滅性挫敗，得票率崩跌至17.2%，僅保住15席。其餘如社民黨、綠黨及左翼黨均獲8席，新政黨BSW也跨越了得票門檻。本次高達77.8%的投票率，反映出大眾對聯邦政府無法振興經濟及高能源價格的強烈不滿。
這對二戰結束後一直執掌德意志聯邦共和國的政黨，構成了迄今最嚴峻的挑戰之一。競選期間一直與選民保持距離的梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)將不得不應對這一結果帶來的衝擊。
對此，選擇黨共同黨魁Alice Weidel表示，這是一次歷史性結果，選民給予了極清晰的授權，其他政黨絕不能忽視。此邦選擇黨領袖候選人Ulrich Siegmund則宣稱「我們寫下了歷史」，表示選民已傳達「現狀無法維持下去」的訊號。他強調，若無法順利組閣，寧可等待基民盟組建的政府在數月內瓦解，並自信表示選擇黨「終將獲勝」。
然而，主流政黨皆反對與選擇黨合作。基民盟籍的此邦總理Sven Schulze重申拒絕合作，但坦言：「有人說這是黑暗的一天，但我認為這就是民主。」基民盟聯邦領袖梅爾茨則曾警告，選擇黨將把德國帶往「深淵」。
Saxony-Anhalt邦人口約200萬，是德國人均GDP最低且人口流失最嚴重的邦。該邦選擇黨已被安全部門判定為極端主義組織，其政見包括啟動「驅逐出境攻勢」、禁止懸掛彩虹旗，以及反對援助烏克蘭等。然而，其激進的大規模驅逐主張，也導致該黨在歐洲極右翼陣營中遭到孤立。
paras_en: On Sunday, June 6, the eastern German state of Saxony‑Anhalt held its state parliamentary election, where the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) achieved a historic landslide. The final results showed the AfD winning 43.8% of the vote – roughly double its share five years ago – and capturing 39 of the 83 seats in the state parliament.

Although it fell three seats short of the 42 needed for an outright majority, this remains the AfD’s best ever performance. If the party ultimately succeeds in forming a government, it would become the first far‑right‑led state administration in Germany since the end of World War II.

By contrast, the governing centre‑right Christian Democratic Union (CDU) suffered a crushing defeat, its vote share collapsing to 17.2% and retaining only 15 seats. The Social Democrats, the Greens and the Left each secured eight seats, while the new BSW party also cleared the electoral threshold. The turnout was a high 77.8%, underscoring widespread dissatisfaction with the federal government’s failure to revive the economy and with soaring energy prices.

This result poses one of the toughest challenges yet for the parties that have ruled the Federal Republic of Germany since the end of the war. Friedrich Merz, who has kept his distance from voters throughout the campaign, will now have to grapple with the political fallout.

AfD co‑leader Alice Weidel called the outcome historic, saying voters had given a crystal‑clear mandate that other parties could not ignore. AfD state leader candidate Ulrich Siegmund declared, “We have made history,” adding that voters were signalling that “the status quo cannot continue.” He warned that if a coalition cannot be formed, the party would rather wait for a CDU‑led government to collapse within months, confidently asserting that the AfD “will ultimately win.”

However, all mainstream parties have ruled out cooperation with the AfD. Saxony‑Anhalt’s CDU premier Sven Schulze reiterated his refusal to work with the far‑right, but admitted, “Some say this is a dark day, but I think this is democracy.” CDU federal leader Merz has warned that the AfD would lead Germany “into the abyss.”

Saxony‑Anhalt, with a population of about two million, has the lowest per‑capita GDP and the most severe population decline among German states. The AfD in the state has been classified by security services as an extremist organization, advocating policies such as a “deportation offensive,” banning rainbow flags and opposing aid to Ukraine. Its radical mass‑deportation stance has also left the party isolated within Europe’s far‑right camp.

items.title: 美債多空迎關鍵一周 兩大事件恐讓長短債同步劇烈波動
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Bonds Face a Pivotal Week; Two Events Could Trigger Simultaneous Sharp Moves in Short‑ and Long‑Term Yields
paras: 美債投資人正為各期限債券可能出現更劇烈震盪預作準備，本周兩項潛在催化因素，可能同時牽動短天期與長天期美債大幅波動。
美國勞動節長周末結束後，歷經政府債市已相當動盪的一周，交易員將聚焦本周兩項關鍵日程，希望藉此研判美國財政部長貝森特與聯準會（Fed）主席沃許的政策意向。
美國財政部預定周三(9日)公布債券買回細節，並於隔日執行。依據擴大後的計畫，買回規模至少將是原定上限的兩倍，市場甚至認為可能擴大至3至5倍。周五(11日)則將公布最新通膨數據，華許與其他Fed官員已暗示，這項數據將是決定本月是否升息的關鍵。
這兩項事件可能使假期縮短的本周行情更為震盪。投資人仍須應對左右美國利率市場的兩股力量：通常主導短期殖利率的貨幣政策，以及著眼於壓低長期借貸成本的財政政策。
就業數據推升升息預期
美國8月就業成長優於預期後，上周五美債殖利率曲線趨平，短期殖利率走高，長天期債券則大致持穩。交易員因而提高對Fed本月升息的押注，但財政部與Fed政策前景仍不明朗，限制市場波動幅度。
加拿大帝國商業銀行私人財富管理固定收益主管Tim Musial表示，就業報告只是「前菜」，9月11日公布的通膨數據才是「主菜」。他也指出，財政部債券買回有別於經濟成長與通膨等基本面因素，是難以預測的挑戰，「在這種環境下，或許應該稍微降低風險」。
買回規模牽動長債行情
財政部擴大債券買回計畫的消息出乎投資人意料，因為公告時間並不在例行季度融資聲明期間。此前，30年期美債殖利率一度升至2007年以來最高水準，截至上周五仍徘徊在約5.25%的高檔。
財政部表示，買回規模將較先前的20億美元「至少增加一倍」，讓貝森特保留政策調整空間。若實際買回金額超過40億美元，可能帶動美債上漲。
通膨數據成Fed決策關鍵
另一方面，沃許上月在傑克森霍爾全球央行年會發表演說時表示，Fed目前的首要重點應放在物價。彭博調查的經濟學家預估，美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）將年增3.4%，剔除波動較大的食品與能源後，核心CPI預估年增2.4%。
根據交換市場定價，截至上周五，投資人認為Fed本月升息1碼的機率約為60%。Fed下一次利率決策將於9月16日公布。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury investors are preparing for potentially sharper volatility across bonds of all maturities, as two possible catalysts this week could simultaneously drive large swings in both short‑term and long‑term U.S. Treasuries.

After the Labor Day long weekend, traders will focus on two key dates this week following an already turbulent week in the government bond market, hoping to gauge the policy intentions of Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell.

The Treasury plans to announce details of a bond buyback on Wednesday (the 9th) and execute it the next day. Under the expanded plan, the buyback size will be at least twice the original cap, with some market participants believing it could be three to five times larger. On Friday (the 11th) the latest inflation data will be released, and Powell and other Fed officials have hinted that this figure will be decisive for whether rates are raised this month.

These two events could make an already compressed trading week even more volatile. Investors will still have to contend with the two forces that drive the U.S. rate market: monetary policy, which typically dominates short‑term yields, and fiscal policy, which aims to keep long‑term borrowing costs low.
Employment data lifts rate‑hike expectations

After August’s employment growth outperformed expectations, the Treasury yield curve flattened last Friday, with short‑term yields rising while long‑term bonds held relatively steady. Traders therefore increased their bets on a Fed rate hike this month, but the outlook for Treasury and Fed policy remains unclear, limiting the magnitude of market moves.

Tim Musial, head of fixed‑income for private wealth at CIBC, said the jobs report was just an "appetizer" and that the inflation data due on September 11 would be the "main course." He also noted that the Treasury’s bond buyback is unrelated to fundamentals such as economic growth and inflation and poses an unpredictable challenge, adding that "in this environment, it may be prudent to dial back risk a bit."
Buyback size influences long‑bond dynamics

The news that the Treasury is expanding its bond buyback program surprised investors because the announcement came outside the regular quarterly financing statements. Earlier, the 30‑year Treasury yield had risen to its highest level since 2007, hovering around 5.25% as of last Friday.

The Treasury said the buyback would be "at least double" the previous $20 billion, giving Secretary Yellen room to adjust policy. If the actual repurchase amount exceeds $40 billion, it could push Treasury prices higher.
Inflation data is key to Fed decisions

Separately, Powell said at the Jackson Hole Global Central Bank Meeting last month that the Fed’s top priority should be price stability. Bloomberg‑surveyed economists project that U.S. CPI for August will rise 3.4% year‑over‑year, with core CPI—excluding the more volatile food and energy components—expected to increase 2.4% annually.

Based on swap‑market pricing as of last Friday, investors assign roughly a 60% probability that the Fed will raise rates by one quarter‑point this month. The Fed’s next rate decision is scheduled for September 16.

items.title: 伊朗宣布將於荷姆茲海峽外設「限制海域」！船舶闖入恐列制裁名單
items.title_en: Iran Announces It Will Designate a "Restricted Zone" Outside the Strait of Hormuz; Vessels Entering May Be Sanctioned
paras: 伊朗與美國軍事對峙持續升溫之際，伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷扎伊（Mohsen Rezaei）週日（6日）表示，伊朗未來幾天將在荷姆茲海峽外宣布設立新的「限制」海域，任何進入該區域的船舶都將被列入制裁名單。
根據伊朗國營媒體《Press TV》報導，雷扎伊在電視專訪中表示，新限制區將從美國海軍目前實施的封鎖線開始，並延伸至波斯灣（Gulf）部分海域。
他警告，任何進入這個新區域的船隻，都將遭到列入制裁名單的處置。
雷扎伊另表示，伊朗與阿曼預計未來幾天簽署一項協議，規劃建立一條穿越荷姆茲海峽的新通道，且通道的進出口都將由伊朗掌控。
他並強調，荷姆茲海峽目前「已完全關閉，並由伊朗武裝部隊控制」。雷扎伊還反駁美國總統川普宣稱這條戰略水道仍維持開放的說法，稱其為「彌天大謊」。
雷扎伊指出，在伊朗關閉荷姆茲海峽之前，每天有超過100艘、總貨運量逾1億噸的船舶通行；如今每天僅有7、8艘運送伊朗所需重要物資的船隻通過。
他表示，美國試圖以高昂成本讓5、6艘船隻通過，但這些船「通常會遭到攻擊」，不過並未進一步說明相關攻擊細節。
雷扎伊表示，伊朗之所以沒有擊沉這些船隻，是因為船上載有石油，一旦擊沉恐對區域環境造成破壞。
除了航運管制，雷扎伊還宣稱，伊朗在48小時前成功測試一款新型反艦飛彈，測試目標位於一艘美國海軍軍艦上方。
他表示：「我們首次在一艘美國軍艦上方測試了反艦飛彈。」
雷扎伊宣稱，這款特殊飛彈讓美軍陷入「地獄」，並迫使美軍「逃走」，但他沒有透露遭涉及的美軍艦艇名稱，也未說明測試發生的具體地點。
另一方面，雷扎伊否認美國經濟封鎖已在伊朗造成大規模饑荒。他接受伊朗國營廣播電視台（IRIB）訪問時表示，美國經濟封鎖正在引發伊朗嚴重饑荒的說法是「謊言」。
他指出，伊朗政府早已為此做好準備，目前擁有充足的食品及基本生活物資庫存。
paras_en: Iran’s top national security council secretary, Mohsen Rezaei, said on Sunday (the 6th) that amid escalating military tensions with the United States, Iran will announce a new “restricted” maritime area outside the Strait of Hormuz in the coming days, and any ship entering that zone will be placed on a sanctions list.

According to Iran’s state‑run media outlet Press TV, Rezaei told a televised interview that the new restricted zone will start from the line of the U.S. Navy’s current blockade and will extend into parts of the Gulf of Persia.
He warned that any vessel that enters this new area will be subject to sanctions.
Rezaei also said Iran and Oman expect to sign an agreement in the next few days to establish a new passage through the Strait of Hormuz, with both entry and exit points under Iranian control.

He stressed that the Strait of Hormuz is now “completely closed and under the control of Iran’s armed forces,” and rebuffed President Trump’s claim that the strategic waterway remains open, calling it a “massive lie.”

Rezaei noted that before Iran shut the Strait, more than 100 ships carrying over 100 million tonnes of cargo passed daily; now only seven or eight vessels delivering essential supplies to Iran get through each day.
He said the United States tries to force five or six ships through at great cost, but those vessels “are usually attacked,” without providing further details on the attacks.
Rezaei explained that Iran has not sunk those ships because they are carrying oil, and sinking them could cause environmental damage to the region.
In addition to the shipping restrictions, Rezaei claimed that Iran successfully tested a new anti‑ship missile 48 hours ago, with the target positioned above a U.S. Navy warship.
He said: “We tested an anti‑ship missile for the first time over a U.S. warship.”
Rezaei asserted that the special missile threw the U.S. forces into “hell” and forced them to “flee,” but he did not disclose the name of the U.S. vessel involved nor the exact location of the test.
On another note, Rezaei denied that the U.S. economic blockade has caused a large‑scale famine in Iran, telling IRIB that claims of severe famine caused by the blockade are “lies.”
He pointed out that the Iranian government has long prepared for such a scenario and currently holds ample stocks of food and basic living supplies.

items.title: 美股周一因勞動節休市
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Closed Monday for Labor Day
paras: 美國股市周一(7日)因勞動節假期休市一天，紐約證券交易所(NYSE)與那斯達克(Nasdaq)均不開盤，美股常規交易全面暫停，期權交易市場也同步關閉，預計將於周二上午 9:30 恢復正常交易。
此外，美國債券市場(包括國債、房貸擔保證券、高收益企業債、市政債及部分貨幣市場)以及場外交易(OTC)市場全數關閉，同樣將在周二重啟。鄰國加拿大的多倫多證券交易所當天也因勞動節休市一日。
市場分析指出，由於美股與美債兩大市場缺席，全球市場的整體流動性在今日將顯著變薄，這在北美交易時段會更加明顯。因此，分析師提醒，在周二市場恢復深度流動性之前，投資人對於美元、黃金或股指期貨的任何顯著波動，都應保持審慎與警惕，避免盲目跟進。
歷史數據顯示，9月份對股市而言通常是個艱難的月份。雖然今年上半年人工智慧(AI)熱潮推動了標普 500 指數走高，但隨著借貸成本上升，近幾周投資人承壓，市場回吐了部分漲幅。
不過，市場的平靜很快就會在周二重開盤後被打破，焦點將迅速轉向通膨與聯準會(Fed)利率政策的辯論。除了周四將公布 8 月生產者物價指數(PPI)外，周五公布的 8 月消費者物價指數CPI，更是市場最關注指標。這兩項數據在下周聯準會召開貨幣政策會議前，將承載極高的市場關注度。
paras_en: U.S. equity markets were closed on Monday (the 7th) for the Labor Day holiday, with both the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Nasdaq not opening. All regular U.S. trading was halted, and the options market was also closed, with normal trading expected to resume at 9:30 a.m. on Tuesday.

In addition, the U.S. bond market – including Treasuries, mortgage‑backed securities, high‑yield corporate bonds, municipal bonds and certain money‑market instruments – as well as the over‑the‑counter (OTC) market were completely shut and will also reopen on Tuesday. Canada’s Toronto Stock Exchange was likewise closed for Labor Day.

Analysts note that the absence of both U.S. equities and U.S. bonds will markedly thin global liquidity today, especially during the North American trading session. They caution investors to remain prudent and vigilant about any significant moves in the dollar, gold or index futures until deep liquidity returns on Tuesday, and to avoid blind chasing.

Historical data show that September is typically a tough month for equities. Although the AI boom lifted the S&P 500 in the first half of the year, rising borrowing costs have pressured investors in recent weeks, prompting a partial unwind of gains.

However, the market’s calm is expected to end quickly after the Tuesday open, with focus shifting to inflation and Fed rate policy debates. In addition to the August Producer Price Index (PPI) due on Thursday, the August Consumer Price Index (CPI) released on Friday will be the most closely watched gauge, both carrying high market attention ahead of the Fed’s monetary policy meeting next week.

items.title: AI樂觀情緒提振科技股 新興市場股市創兩個月新高
items.title_en: AI optimism lifts tech stocks, emerging market equities hit two‑month high
paras: 受新型人工智慧模型釋出的利好預期提振，權重科技股周一(7日)強勁上漲，成功抵消了地緣政治緊張與油價走高給市場情緒帶來的拖累。
MSCI新興市場股票指數周一一度上漲1.4%，創下自同年6月26日以來的最高水準。其中，南韓綜合股指KOSPI指數表現尤為強勁，大漲超過3%。新興市場貨幣指數也微幅上漲0.1%，在過去13個交易日中已有12個交易日錄得上漲。
此次上漲主要受到科技類股的強勢領跑推動，追隨了前一個交易日美國晶片股的升勢。
OpenAI此前宣布推出新一代技術「GPT-6」，並將其定位為邁向通用人工智慧(AGI)進程中的關鍵里程碑。此消息極大提振了市場信心，紐約梅隆銀行(BNY)駐香港亞太高級市場策略師Wee Khoon Chong指出，科技類股的亮眼表現顯著蓋過了原油價格上漲的利空，提振了包含南韓綜合指數、台股以及日經指數在內的區域市場情緒。
特別是，受半導體板塊走強及外資持續流入韓股推動，韓元兌美元匯率周一升至近兩年來的最高點，其相對強弱指標(RSI)更是創下2013年以來最高。
然而，市場並非毫無阻力。受美伊兩國在荷姆茲海峽互相襲擊油輪事件影響，原油價格走高。此外，強勁的美國就業數據亦加深了市場對於聯準會(Fed)可能很快升息的預期，導致除了科技股外的多數行業指數普遍下跌，石油進口國如印尼和菲律賓的貨幣也因而走弱。
paras_en: Weighty technology stocks surged strongly on Monday (the 7th) on expectations of a boost from the release of new AI models, successfully offsetting the drag on market sentiment from geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices.

The MSCI Emerging Markets Index rose as much as 1.4% on Monday, hitting its highest level since June 26 of this year. The South Korean composite KOSPI index was especially strong, jumping more than 3%. The emerging‑market currency index also edged up 0.1%, marking gains on 12 of the past 13 trading days.
The rally was driven mainly by a strong lead from technology stocks, following the rise in U.S. chip shares the previous trading day.

OpenAI recently announced its next‑generation technology “GPT‑6,” positioning it as a key milestone toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). The news greatly boosted market confidence; BNY’s senior Asia‑Pacific market strategist in Hong Kong, Wee Khoon Chong, said the impressive performance of tech stocks more than offset the negative impact of higher oil prices, lifting regional sentiment in markets such as the South Korean composite index, Taiwan’s market and the Nikkei.

In particular, a strong semiconductor sector and continued foreign inflows into Korean equities pushed the won‑to‑dollar rate up to its highest level in nearly two years on Monday, with its relative strength index hitting a peak not seen since 2013.

However, the market faced headwinds. Oil prices rose after a tanker clash between the U.S. and Iran in the Hormuz Strait. Strong U.S. employment data also deepened expectations that the Fed may raise rates soon, causing most sector indices outside tech to fall and weakening the currencies of oil‑importing countries such as Indonesia and the Philippines.

items.title: 日本疑拋售美債為創紀錄日元干預融資！外匯儲備跌破1兆美元
items.title_en: Japan May Be Selling U.S. Treasuries to Fund Record Yen Intervention, Forex Reserves Slip Below $1 Trillion
paras: 日本可能正透過出售美國國債等海外證券，為創紀錄的日元干預行動籌措資金，引發市場再度擔憂美債供給壓力。
日本財務省週一（7日）公布外匯儲備數據顯示，日本8月底的外國證券持有量較前一個月減少878億美元，降幅與同期日元干預規模高度接近。
儘管財務省並未進一步揭露這些證券的具體組成及到期期限，但市場參與者普遍估計，日本外匯儲備約70%配置於美國國債。
此外，從市場價格變化來看，10年期美國國債8月底的價格較7月底僅小幅下跌，代表債券估值變動對外國證券持有量減少的影響相當有限，也進一步支持日本可能主動出售美債的判斷。
日本財務省此前已確認，截至8月26日的一個月內，日本當局共動用約15.4兆日元（約986億美元）進行匯市干預，創下單月歷史新高，其中部分操作是與美國共同實施。
在日元承受壓力之際，日本當局大規模進場支撐日元，而美日採取聯合干預的形式，也反映雙方在匯率議題上的協調。
與此同時，日本透過出售美債等資產籌措干預資金，也讓市場更加關注美國國債市場可能面臨的供給壓力，尤其是在期中選舉臨近的背景下。
美國方面近期同樣提高對美債市場穩定性的關注。財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）日前宣布，在截至11月4日的兩個月期間，美國政府將長期債券回購規模提高一倍。市場普遍將此視為抑制長天期美債殖利率上升的措施。
受此影響，日本外匯儲備總額減少946億美元至9,950億美元，跌破1兆美元大關。不過，日本當局認為，剩餘儲備規模仍足以支應未來可能進行的匯市干預。
除外國證券外，日本外匯存款也可作為潛在干預資金來源。數據顯示，8月底外匯存款較前月減少69億美元。
值得注意的是，日本財務大臣片山皋月（Satsuki Katayama）在美日聯合干預後表示，未來若需要進一步進行干預，也可能使用聯準會提供給外國及國際貨幣當局的回購機制（FIMA Repo Facility）。
透過該機制，日本每天最多可取得600億美元流動性，且不必出售美國國債，因而能降低干預行動對美債殖利率造成的衝擊，也讓日本未來可動用的干預空間進一步擴大。
paras_en: Japan may be raising funds for a record yen intervention by selling U.S. Treasury and other overseas securities, sparking renewed market worries about pressure on U.S. Treasury supply.

The Ministry of Finance released foreign‑exchange reserve data on Monday (the 7th) showing that Japan's holdings of foreign securities fell by $87.8 billion at the end of August compared with the previous month, a decline closely matching the scale of yen intervention during the same period.

Although the ministry did not disclose the exact composition or maturities of those securities, market participants generally estimate that about 70% of Japan's foreign‑exchange reserves are allocated to U.S. Treasuries.

Moreover, market price movements indicate that the price of the 10‑year U.S. Treasury at the end of August slipped only slightly from the end of July, meaning bond‑valuation changes had a limited effect on the drop in foreign‑security holdings and further support the view that Japan may be actively selling Treasuries.

The ministry previously confirmed that in the month ending August 26, Japanese authorities used roughly ¥15.4 trillion (about $98.6 billion) for currency‑market intervention, a historic monthly high, with part of the operation carried out jointly with the United States.

As the yen came under pressure, Japanese authorities stepped in on a large scale to support it, and the joint U.S.–Japan intervention reflects coordination between the two sides on exchange‑rate issues.

At the same time, Japan’s fundraising through the sale of Treasuries and other assets has heightened market focus on possible supply‑side stress in the U.S. Treasury market, especially with the mid‑term elections approaching.

The United States has likewise heightened attention to Treasury‑market stability. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent recently announced that for the two‑month period ending November 4, the U.S. government will double the size of its long‑term bond repurchase program, a move widely seen as a measure to curb long‑term Treasury yield rises.

As a result, Japan’s total foreign‑exchange reserves fell by $94.6 billion to $995 billion, slipping below the $1 trillion threshold. Nevertheless, Japanese authorities believe the remaining reserve pool is still sufficient to fund any future currency‑market interventions.

Beyond foreign securities, Japan’s foreign‑exchange deposits also constitute a potential source of intervention funds, with data showing that deposits fell by $6.9 billion at the end of August compared with the prior month.

It is noteworthy that Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama, after the U.S.–Japan joint intervention, said that if further intervention is needed, Japan could also tap the Federal Reserve’s FIMA Repo Facility offered to foreign and international monetary authorities.

Through that facility, Japan can obtain up to $60 billion of daily liquidity without having to sell U.S. Treasuries, thereby reducing the impact of intervention on Treasury yields and further expanding Japan’s future intervention capacity.

items.title: 九月效應碰上史上第二高估值 歷史將再重演？
items.title_en: September Effect Meets Historically Second‑Highest Valuation – Will History Repeat?
paras: 歷史上，九月一向是標普500指數表現最差的月份之一，甚至被稱為「九月效應」。然而，財經專欄作家Steven Porrello指出，今年的九月不僅籠罩在傳統的走弱陰影下，還適逢美股估值達到歷史第二高的時期，使市場不確定性大增。
他強調，今年的異常與真實的市場不確定性交織在一起。投資人擔憂的問題包括： 頑固通膨、能源價格上漲、央行鷹派信號、美國公債殖利率攀升、美加貿易戰、美伊之間的實際戰爭，以及對AI泡沫的擔憂。
雖然市場也有企業獲利飆升、經濟穩定成長，以及上漲動能逐漸擴散至超大型領頭羊以外等利多，但隱憂仍不容忽視。
Porrello表示，一項可靠的估值指標已拉響警報，即「席勒本益比(CAPE)」正處於歷史高位。這一指標平均了標普500指數過去10年經通膨調整後的盈餘，用以平滑景氣循環的波動。回顧過去155年的歷史，CAPE的平均值僅約18，歷史最高紀錄是網路泡沫時期的44，而如今的數據卻已高達約41。
Porrello認為，高CAPE值雖不直接「導致」崩盤，卻反映出股價已被嚴重高估，更容易受到任何觸發因素而引發劇烈的拋售潮。
雖然目前的牛市有可能重演網路泡沫破滅的結局，但Porrello指出，歷史不會完全重演，許多優質企業仍將持續獲利。因此，他建議投資人切勿恐慌、過度反應或盲目預測市場高低點。
Porrello主張，此時最佳策略是繼續持有並投資於自己深信的優質公司，即便在面臨大跌與壞消息時堅守立場看似有些「愚蠢」，但歷史往往會回報願意忍受波動、著眼長線的投資人。
paras_en: Historically, September has been one of the worst months for the S&P 500, even dubbed the “September effect.” Yet financial columnist Steven Porrello notes that this September is not only shrouded in the usual weakness but also coincides with U.S. equity valuations at the second‑highest level ever, dramatically raising market uncertainty.

He stresses that this year’s abnormality is intertwined with genuine market uncertainty. Investors are worried about stubborn inflation, rising energy prices, hawkish central‑bank signals, climbing U.S. Treasury yields, the U.S.–Canada trade dispute, an actual war between the U.S. and Iran, and concerns over an AI bubble.
Although there are bullish factors such as soaring corporate earnings, steady economic growth, and momentum spreading beyond the mega‑cap leaders, the underlying worries cannot be ignored.

Porrello points out that a reliable valuation gauge has sounded the alarm: the Cyclically Adjusted Price‑Earnings ratio (CAPE) is at a historic high. This metric averages the S&P 500’s inflation‑adjusted earnings over the past ten years to smooth out business‑cycle fluctuations. Over the past 155 years, the CAPE’s average is about 18, its peak was 44 during the dot‑com bubble, and today it sits around 41.
Porrello believes that while a high CAPE does not directly cause a crash, it signals that stocks are severely overvalued and thus more vulnerable to any trigger that could spark a sharp sell‑off.

Although the current bull market could end up mirroring the dot‑com bust, Porrello notes history will not repeat exactly and many high‑quality companies will continue to generate profits. Therefore, he advises investors not to panic, overreact, or blindly try to time market highs and lows.

Porrello argues that the best strategy now is to keep holding and investing in companies you firmly believe in; even if staying the course during steep declines and bad news may seem “foolish,” history tends to reward those who endure volatility and focus on the long term.

items.title: 〈台幣〉偏強整理創近3個月高點 升值7.8分收31.552元
items.title_en: TWD Strengthens, Consolidates Near 3‑Month High, Gains 7.8 ¢ to 31.552
paras: 儘管目前市場預期美國聯準會9月升息機率過半，不過，隨著資金再度簇擁AI相關電子股，台股加權指數今(7)日強彈775點，新台幣早盤升貶互見，午盤過後越走越強，一度創6月中旬以來新高，終場收在31.552元，升值7.8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值18.32億美元。
新台幣今日以31.61元、升值2分開出後，早盤升貶互見低見31.651元，但午盤過後偏強，最高來到31.505元，全日高低價差1.46角。
觀察主要亞幣全面走升，以日元飆升0.7%最多，其次為新台幣收升0.25%，韓元升0.2%左右，泰銖升逾0.1%，人民幣和星元小升0.05%上下，美元指數小貶0.1%左右。
國泰證期研究部指出，美國 8 月非農就業人口大增 16.2 萬人，遠高於市場預期的 5.6 萬人，且 7 月數據大幅上修至增加 2.1 萬人， 強韌的就業數據推升緊縮預期，CME FedWatch 顯示 9 月升息 1 碼機率跳升至約 60%。
而本周市場焦點轉向即將公布的美國 CPI和PPI 數據，通膨走勢將成為聯準會利率決策分水嶺，仍須留意市場對高利率恐維持更久的擔憂。
paras_en: Despite market expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve has more than a 50% chance of raising rates in September, the Taiwan weighted index surged 775 points today (the 7th), as funds once again flocked to AI‑related semiconductor stocks. The New Taiwan dollar fluctuated in the early session but grew stronger after lunch, briefly hitting a new high not seen since mid‑June and closing at 31.552, a 7.8‑cent appreciation, with Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers handling $1.832 billion in turnover.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.61, up 2 cents, and slipped to a low of 31.651 in the early session, but after lunch it turned bullish, reaching a high of 31.505, with the day's high‑low spread at 1.46 ¢.

Major Asian currencies were broadly higher, led by the Japanese yen which jumped 0.7%. The New Taiwan dollar rose 0.25%, the Korean won about 0.2%, the Thai baht more than 0.1%, while the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each edged up roughly 0.05%; the U.S. dollar index fell about 0.1%.

Citi Securities Research noted that U.S. non‑farm payrolls surged by 162,000 in August, far exceeding the market’s 56,000 forecast, and July’s figure was sharply revised up by 21,000. The robust employment data lifted tightening expectations, and CME FedWatch shows the probability of a 25‑basis‑point rate hike in September jumping to roughly 60%.

This week’s market focus shifts to the upcoming U.S. CPI and PPI releases, as inflation trends will be a watershed for the Fed’s rate‑setting decisions, and investors remain wary of concerns that high rates may need to be maintained longer than expected.

items.title: 半導體強勁與外資湧入 韓元匯率衝上兩年高點
items.title_en: Strong Semiconductor Momentum and Foreign Inflows Push Won to Two-Year High
paras: 韓元兌美元匯率周一(7日)強升，匯率一度上漲1.3%，至1,334.70韓元，創下自2024年10月，接近兩年以來新高。
近期韓元的反彈力道極為強勁，相較於2026年7月的低點，韓元已大幅回升了約250韓元，今年以來的累計升幅則達到約6%。
本次韓元強勢上漲主要受到多重利多因素推動。其中，強勁的出口貿易奠定了堅實基礎。今年以來，南韓累計出口額已創下7,094億美元的歷史新高，提前外加超越2025年全年的紀錄。其中，受惠於人工智慧(AI)晶片需求引爆，1至8月半導體出口額大幅增長了169.6%。
其次，外資持續湧入股市提供關鍵動能，周一外資大舉買入超過8,000億韓元(約5.98億美元)的南韓Kospi指數成份股，這已是外資連續第三個交易日淨流入，並由三星電子與SK海力士等半導體巨頭領漲。
此外，出口商累積了大量外匯收益並延遲兌換，使南韓五大銀行的企業美元存款攀升至約770億美元的歷史新高。
儘管市場對聯準會9月升息的預期升至57%至60%之間，這可能為韓元帶來一定阻力，但外資對南韓資產的持續需求仍為匯率提供強大支撐。
不過，分析師也指出，未來的升值步伐可能會面臨挑戰。紐約梅隆銀行高級策略師 Geoffrey Yu 表示，隨著韓元漲勢顯得越發緊繃，可能會促使南韓國內資產管理機構解除部分海外資產的避險部位，或是推動南韓散戶重啟海外股票投資。
paras_en: The won‑dollar exchange rate surged sharply on Monday (the 7th), rising as much as 1.3% to 1,334.70 won, marking the highest level since October 2024 and a near two‑year peak.
The won’s recent rebound has been exceptionally strong; compared with its low in July 2026, it has recovered by roughly 250 won, and the cumulative gain this year is about 6%.

The current won rally is driven by multiple bullish factors. Robust export trade has laid a solid foundation, with South Korea’s cumulative exports this year reaching a record $709.4 billion, already surpassing the full‑year record for 2025. In particular, AI chip demand has spurred a 169.6% surge in semiconductor exports from January to August.

In addition, continued foreign inflows into the equity market have provided key momentum. On Monday, foreign investors bought more than 8 trillion won (about $598 million) of KOSPI constituent stocks, marking the third consecutive day of net foreign purchases, led by semiconductor giants Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

Furthermore, exporters have accumulated large foreign‑exchange earnings and delayed conversion, pushing corporate dollar deposits at South Korea’s five major banks to a historic high of roughly $77 billion.

Although market expectations for a Fed rate hike in September have risen to between 57% and 60%, potentially weighing on the won, sustained foreign demand for South Korean assets continues to underpin the currency strongly.

Analysts caution that the appreciation pace may face challenges ahead. BNY Mellon senior strategist Geoffrey Yu noted that as the won’s rally tightens, domestic asset managers might unwind some overseas hedges and retail investors could resume overseas stock investments.

items.title: 日元行情正在好轉 兌歐元、英鎊與瑞郎率先走強
items.title_en: Yen Moves Higher, Leading Gains Against Euro, Pound and Franc
paras: 外匯交易員對日元的看法日益樂觀，這項轉變率先反映在主要交叉匯率。日元近期兌歐元、瑞士法郎及英鎊走強，相關漲勢可能進一步延伸至美元，帶動美元兌日元匯率續跌。
日本當局實際干預與口頭干預接連出現，加上市場對日本央行升息的預期升溫，正逐步改善日元的整體環境。另一方面，日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能將更多海外資金匯回國內、轉進日本債券，也成為支撐日元的潛在因素。
值得注意的是，在美元兌日元上周跌至155關卡前夕，投機交易員一度增加日元淨空頭部位，但這些部位可能已經大幅削減。由於歐元及瑞郎淨空頭部位仍處低檔，也讓交易員在日本央行公布利率決策前，仍有充足空間透過交叉匯率建立日元多頭部位。
隨著市場對日本央行轉向鷹派的預期升高，投資人將關注9月18日的利率決策是否以9比0全票通過升息，以及行長植田和男會後是否保留10月再次升息的可能性。
此外，隨著日元逼近155關口，空頭踩踏風險急劇升溫。摩根大通策略師田中俊雅等人警告，若美元兌日元貶破155，龐大的空頭部位恐被逼加速解除，引發連鎖賣盤。
根據摩根大通估計，目前仍有約16至17兆日元的看空部位尚未平倉，若完全解除，理論上可能將匯價推入142至146區間，但其基準判斷仍是美元兌日元處於155至165區間。
另一重大不確定性來自日本官方。最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，對近期日元走勢「既不滿意，也沒有感到安心」，日本仍處「高度警戒狀態」，被解讀為可能繼續干預的訊號。
分析人士認為，9月18日BOJ會議後恰逢「白銀周」假期，流動性下降，不排除當局利用此時段行動。
paras_en: Forex traders are becoming increasingly optimistic about the yen, a shift first reflected in the major cross‑rates. The yen has recently strengthened against the euro, Swiss franc and pound, and the rally could extend to the dollar, pushing the USD/JPY rate lower further.

Actual and verbal interventions by Japanese authorities have appeared in succession, and rising market expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike are gradually improving the yen’s overall environment. Meanwhile, the Government Pension Investment Fund may repatriate more overseas assets into domestic Japanese bonds, providing another potential support for the yen.

It is noteworthy that, just before the dollar‑yen slipped to the 155 level last week, speculative traders briefly increased net short positions in the yen, but those positions have likely been cut sharply. Because net short positions on the euro and franc remain low, traders still have ample room to build yen long positions via cross‑rates before the BOJ announces its rate decision.

With market expectations rising that the BOJ will turn hawkish, investors will watch whether the September 18 rate decision is approved unanimously 9‑0 and whether Governor Kazuo Ueda will keep the option of another hike in October after the meeting.

Furthermore, as the yen approaches the 155 threshold, the risk of a short‑covering squeeze is heating up. JPMorgan strategists such as Toshimasa Tanaka warned that if USD/JPY falls below 155, the massive short side could be forced to unwind rapidly, triggering a cascade of sell orders.

JPMorgan estimates that about ¥16‑17 trillion of short positions remain open; if fully unwound, the yen could theoretically be pushed into the 142‑146 range, although its baseline view still places USD/JPY in the 155‑165 band.

A further major uncertainty comes from Japanese officials. Senior foreign‑exchange official Jun Mimura said he is “neither satisfied nor reassured” by the recent yen moves and that Japan remains in a “high‑alert state,” a comment read as a possible signal of continued intervention.
Analysts note that the BOJ meeting on September 18 falls during the “Silver Week” holiday, when liquidity drops, and it cannot be ruled out that authorities might act during that window.
